title: Head of Account Management (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

Client Impact at Upvest owns our clients' journey from signature to go-live and beyond, spanning Launch, Migrations, Account Management, Client Experience and Integration Success. Once a client is live, Account Management takes over: we own the relationship end to end, grow it commercially, run it strategically and make sure our clients see Upvest as a partner, not a vendor. Client satisfaction is one of the things that sets us apart from incumbents, and recommendations from our live clients have already been key to new wins.

We are looking for a Head of Account Management to lead this team and Upvest's live client portfolio, which includes some of Europe's best-known fintechs, neobrokers and banks. You will own the commercial development of the portfolio (renewals, upsell, ARR and revenue retention) and the senior relationships behind it, lead a team of senior Account Managers, and build the operating model that lets us scale. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will sit across the table from client C-levels yourself, not only manage the people who do.

You will report directly to Jens Maluck, VP Client Impact, and work closely with Growth, Product, Launch, Client Experience and Finance.

What you’ll do:

  • Commercial growth

    • Own the commercial development of the live client portfolio: renewals, expansions and upsells, against budget and upsell targets

    • Spot commercial opportunities and leveraging knowledge across the portfolio

    • Lead commercial negotiations for live clients, including pricing

    • Build strategic account plans that set out each client's growth path with Upvest, from new use cases and asset classes to new functionality and geographies

    • Advise clients on their end-user investment offering (product, pricing, promotions, conversion), because the better our clients perform, the better Upvest performs

    • Provide case studies and references that help win new business

  • Client ownership

    • Be the senior counterpart for client leadership teams, from handover after go-live through renewals and escalations

    • Lead QBRs, Steering Committees and executive alignment, keeping stakeholders aligned from C-level to technical teams

    • Act as the filter between our clients and the wider Upvest organisation: answer most product, asset class and commercial questions directly, run client meetings independently with your team, and bring in others only where they add real value

    • Be the first point of escalation for live clients, resolving issues quickly and coordinating the wider organisation where needed

    • Represent the voice of the client inside Upvest, channelling structured feedback to Product, Operations and Growth

    • Safeguard the partnership by ensuring contract adherence on both sides

  • Performance and insight

    • Own the portfolio KPIs: ARR, net and gross revenue retention, and client satisfaction (CSAT and Account Health Score)

    • Track client performance (users, conversions, assets under custody, trading activity) against plan, and use anonymised benchmarks to help clients improve

    • Own the client input to the annual budget and the monthly actuals vs budget review with Finance

    • Report to senior management on account health, risks and opportunities, with clear actionable recommendations

  • Team and operating model

    • Lead, hire and develop a team of senior Account Managers, setting a high bar for quality, execution speed and commercial impact

    • Define and continuously improve how Upvest manages its live clients: account tiering, governance cadences, account health scoring, documentation and tooling

    • Drive AI adoption across Account Management, using Claude and system integrations to automate analysis, reporting and preparation work

    • Work very closely with Client Experience who own the day to day operational alignment and ticket resolution

What you bring:

  • Experience: 8+ years in account management, client success or strategic relationship management for B2B enterprise clients, of which 3+ years leading an account management or client team

  • Investment and brokerage expertise: You can discuss asset types in depth (equities, ETFs, funds and MMFs, bonds, securitised derivatives, crypto) and the trading, custody, settlement and fee economics behind them. Ideally, you gained this in B2B investment infrastructure or B2C brokerage (e.g. a neobroker or the investment offering of a digital bank)

  • Commercial track record: You have owned renewals, upsells and negotiations end to end, ideally against NRR / GRR targets or a commission plan, and you can name the deals you generated

  • Relevant background: Regulated fintech or banking with financial institutions as clients, or B2B API, embedded finance or enterprise SaaS

  • Product mindset: You are eager to understand the product in depth and E2E, and have a drive to represent it to the client without the Product team present. You understand the value of standardisation and automation over customisation

  • People leadership: You have led a team of senior individual contributors, and you can show both a strong team culture and raising the bar (coaching, performance management, stepping in when output falls short)

  • Operating model builder: You have built playbooks, improved processes and implemented systems that let a team scale

  • Data-driven: You run accounts on KPIs (client performance, forecast vs actuals, adoption etc.)

  • AI-enabled: You use AI hands-on every day (ideally Claude), are comfortable connecting it to business systems via MCP or similar, and can walk us through workflows you automated

  • Executive presence: You are a trusted counterpart for C-level stakeholders and lead QBRs, SteerCos and difficult commercial conversations without senior back-up

  • Ownership: You are the go-to person for your area: you communicate proactively, flag risks early and take a clear position. You are hands-on and not looking for a pure manage-the-managers role

It’s great if you have:

  • B2C brokerage experience, to guide clients on product design, pricing, promotions, conversion and activity

  • Experience with country expansion (local market specifics, tax and regulatory set-up, market launch)

  • A network and market insight in Upvest's core European markets (e.g. Germany, Netherlands, Spain, UK, France)

  • Experience with migrations or large client transitions

  • German and/or Spanish language skills

  • Location preference: Berlin-based preferred. Alternatively London-based or remote, willingness to travel to Berlin every couple of weeks

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Head of Compliance
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

title: Head of Regulatory Affairs, Senior Manager
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

Checkout.com holds licences in many countries, and the way we work with our supervisors matters more every year. We are creating a new Regulatory Affairs function to lead that work, and we are looking for the person to build it.

As Head of Regulatory Affairs, you will manage our supervisory relationships day to day and run the formal work that comes with them: information requests, thematic reviews, inspections and examinations. You will also shape how the new function works and where it grows, working closely with the Director of External Affairs.You will bring together the right people across Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Product and Tech, and make sure everything we send is accurate, consistent and on time.

You will start hands-on, building the foundations yourself, leveraging advanced AI tools, then build a team of regulatory affairs specialists across our major markets over time.

What you'll do

Build the function

  • Shape our approach to supervisory engagement across our regulated entities.

  • Design how Regulatory Affairs works day to day, including how it works with Compliance, Legal, Risk and the business.

  • Help plan where the team grows, including which countries need local specialists and in what order.

  • Build a clear view of supervisory risk across the group and use it to set priorities.

  • Advise executives on what our supervisors expect and how upcoming supervisory activity will affect the business.

Manage our supervisory relationships

  • Run the regular cycle of supervisory meetings: preparation, briefing senior colleagues, attending and following up.

  • Keep a clear record of what we have told each regulator and what we have committed to.

  • Own the protocol for how we engage with supervisors, so colleagues know who speaks to whom and when.

  • Spot emerging issues early and raise them with senior leadership.

Run regulatory requests

  • Own regulator information requests and thematic reviews from receipt to submission: scope, owners, deadlines, evidence, version control and quality checks.

  • Act as a single front door for the business, so teams get one clear request instead of several.

  • Challenge draft responses for gaps and inconsistencies before they go out.

Lead inspections and examinations

  • Run inspections, examinations and skilled-person reviews as programmes, from the opening notice to the closing meeting.

  • Set the plan and the narrative, coordinate evidence, and prepare and rehearse subject-matter experts and senior leaders.

  • Run a lessons-learned review after each engagement and improve the process for next time.

Build the team and the infrastructure

  • Hire, develop and lead a team of regulatory affairs specialists across our major markets.

  • Build the playbooks, templates, trackers and governance the function will run on.

  • Build a library of past submissions so we can reuse good work.

  • Set up regular reporting to senior leadership and entity boards on open requests, inspections and commitments.

What we are looking for

  • A builder. You have set up a function, team or process from scratch, and you enjoy turning an open brief into something that works.

  • Significant experience as a regulatory affairs manager / lead at a regulated payments, e-money or fintech firm.

  • Hands-on experience running regulatory information requests and inspections end to end, ideally across more than one country.

  • Time in a supervisory team at a major financial regulator, such as the FCA, ACPR, MAS or CBUAE, is a strong advantage.

  • Strategic judgement. You can set a clear direction, explain it to executives and turn it into a plan.

  • Excellent project management. You can run several deadlines with many contributors at once and keep every one of them on track.

  • A track record of keeping calm under pressure.

  • Sound judgement on when to bring in Legal or Compliance.

  • Credibility with regulators and the trust of senior executives.

  • Impeccable written communication.

  • People management experience, or clear readiness to build and lead a team

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

DP World hat es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, Grenzen zu überschreiten und die Kluft zwischen allen Nationen und Kulturen zu überbrücken – nicht nur in dem, was wir tun, sondern auch in unserem Verhalten.


Wir sind bestrebt, eine Kultur zu schaffen, in der sich jeder respektiert, unterstützt und befähigt fühlt, sein volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen. Wir glauben, dass die Akzeptanz von Inklusion und Vielfalt Innovation und Wachstum vorantreibt und uns hilft, Menschen, Unternehmen und Gesellschaften zu verbinden. Freie Geister und unterschiedliche Perspektiven verändern unsere Welt, und gemeinsam können wir verändern, was möglich ist.

title: Human Resources Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role
You'll own the people agenda for our teams in France, where the large majority of Vibe's engineering and product talent sit. You'll be the go-to HR partner for our technical organization, working hand in hand with the CTO, the SVP Product, and the SVP Engineering, while leading employee relations and French labor law compliance across France. You'll report to our HRBP Director in New York and partner closely with our Chief People Officer, based in Paris. This role exists because our European headcount is scaling fast and the technical org needs a dedicated partner on the ground. You'll get real ownership of a strategic region, direct exposure to senior technical leaders, and the chance to shape how we grow talent across three continents.


What You'll Do

  • Partner with leaders on the full talent lifecycle, from onboarding to retention.

  • Serve as the primary HR partner to the CTO, SVP Product, and SVP Engineering on their technical teams.

  • Lead employee relations across France, from everyday cases to complex situations.

  • Own compliance with French labor law across all people practices.

  • Coach managers across the region to raise the bar on people management.

  • Advise on organizational design as the technical org scales.

  • Build career frameworks that give technical teams clear growth paths.

  • Adapt company-wide People programs to the local context: Total Rewards, performance, mobility.

What You Need

  • 3–5 years as an HRBP or HR generalist, including time in both a scale-up and a larger group.

  • Working knowledge of French labor law and employee relations.

  • Experience supporting engineering and product teams.

  • Fluency in English (our working language) and French.

  • Familiarity with People programs like Total Rewards, performance cycles, or internal mobility.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience partnering with teams across multiple countries and time zones.

  • A track record of connecting people decisions to business outcomes.

Our Values
At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.
You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.
This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.
If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.


What We Offer

The pay range for this role is €60,000–€90,000.
At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it.

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

Our Interview Process
We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect — no surprises, no ghosting.

  • Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

  • Manager interview — Meet the person you'd work with directly.

  • Take-home assignment + live debrief — A real problem, not a trick. We'll work through it together.

  • Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar.

  • Offer — Fast. We don't let good decisions sit.

Equal Opportunity

title: Implementation Manager
descriptionHtml:
Location: Dublin or London, hybrid, minimum 2 days per week in office

Full-time, permanent


About Kota

Kota is making insurance and retirement benefits as accessible as modern software. We do this across two products: Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance and retirement product for other platforms.

Today we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at companies including Carwow, Tines, Zoe and Remote. Founded in 2022, we've raised more than €20M from investors including EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone and Frontline, along with founders and executives from Workday, Remote, Personio and OpenAI.

The Role

Kota Embed powers the benefits layer inside other platforms, mostly employers of record and HR platforms with employees across multiple countries. Partner launches and growth require best-in-class delivery: integration build, benefits set up market by market, data migration, seamless end-customer product experience, and support readiness.

We're hiring an Implementation Manager to own those launches end to end, plus the renewals that follow. You'll run around five at once working alongside Embed Sales and Account Management teams.

This is a delivery role with real teeth. Partners tell their own clients when benefits are going live based on what we tell them, so the dates matter and the person who owns them has to be able to hold a line and change it early when it needs changing.


What You'll Do

  • Own new partner launches from signature to live: scope, plan, cadence, dependencies, blockers, the lot

  • Run roughly five concurrent projects, and know which one needs you this week

  • Align product, engineering, benefits and commercial around the same plan and the same dates

  • Define what go-live actually means for each launch, and get everyone using the same definition

  • Chase blockers rather than report them, including with people who don't work for you

  • Join partner calls alongside the Account Executive or Account Manager, and lead the delivery half of them

  • Keep internal tracking in Asana and the partner-facing view in sync

  • Spot a slipping date early and say so, to us and to the partner

What We're Looking For

  • Experience running multiple customer-facing implementations at once rather than one large programme

  • Either technical depth, comfortable with APIs and integration conversations, or a strong data and analytics background. We're open on which

  • A track record of getting things delivered through people who don't report to you

  • Calm and process-driven, with the judgement to know when the process is in the way

  • Comfortable in front of customers, including when the news isn't good

  • Able to hold a date, defend it, and change it early rather than late

  • Highly organised and proactive - enough to run five things properly rather than five things approximately

  • Comfortable with pace and with processes that are still being built


Benefits, HR tech, payments, fintech, cross-border or migration experience is a plus. You don't need to know anything about insurance or pensions before you start.


Our Values

  • Have Integrity. We care deeply about our why and it won't jeopardise our how.

  • Care Deeply. Our products are our story, we look at the details, go the extra mile to delight customers.

  • Own Your Ship. Ask why, do the work, get the data, solve the problem, be an owner.

  • Raise the Bar. We continuously look to push past good enough. Expect more, move faster, and never stop raising your and the team's standards.

  • Play to Win. We exist because we decided to say no to the norm, now we do this everyday.


Our Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter screen, 30 mins. Cover the basics and make sure we're aligned

  2. Competency interview, 45 mins. With our Strategy & Operations Associate

  3. Task, 60 mins. A real implementation scenario. We'll send it in advance and work through it together on the call with GM + 1

  • Group life assurance via Kota (location dependent)

descriptionHtml:
We are PMG

PMG, a global independent platform company engineered for impact, integrates business strategy, media, creative, and data within a single operating model powered by our proprietary operating system, Alli. With more than 1,000 employees, PMG partners with brands including Apple, Nike, Dropbox, Experian, Sephora, and Whole Foods. Who You'll Be Working With

At PMG, our Influencer & Branded Content team is at the intersection of culture, storytelling, and strategy, helping brands connect with audiences in authentic, meaningful ways. We craft high-impact influencer campaigns that go beyond traditional advertising, driving engagement, building brand affinity, and delivering measurable results across social, digital, and experiential platforms.

As the Influencer & Branded Content Senior Manager, you’ll play a key leadership role in shaping and delivering influencer and creator strategies across PMG’s clients. You’ll collaborate with creators, talent agencies, media strategists, content teams, client leaders, and brand partners to develop programs that connect cultural relevance with business impact. You’ll help strengthen PMG’s influencer and creator marketing capabilities by establishing scalable best practices, developing strong talent and platform relationships, and ensuring a high standard of strategy, execution, measurement, and client service.

You’ll help advance the future of branded content at PMG by identifying emerging creator trends, exploring new content formats and platforms, and translating innovation into actionable opportunities for clients. You’ll also lead and develop team members, helping them strengthen their strategic thinking, channel expertise, and ability to deliver exceptional work.

If you’re passionate about shaping culture through creator-driven storytelling, using data to guide meaningful decisions, and building innovative influencer programs that deliver measurable impact, this is the place to make your mark.

What You Will Do

  • Lead full-scale influencer and branded content campaigns from brief to delivery—including strategy development, talent identification, negotiations, publisher partnerships, content approvals, and reporting—translating business objectives, audience insights, and cultural trends into impactful creator programs.
  • Oversee campaign strategy and execution in partnership with internal team members, ensuring every detail is delivered with excellence, on time, aligned with brand standards and client business objectives, and optimized for measurable success.
  • Manage and mentor a team of professionals, supporting workload planning, day-to-day execution, coaching, feedback, performance management, and long-term professional development while building a culture of collaboration, creativity, and accountability.
  • Partner with the Director of Influencer & Branded Content to help evolve PMG’s offerings, develop scalable frameworks, best practices, processes, and measurement approaches, and train team members to grow their expertise and impact.
  • Serve as a senior subject matter expert in influencer marketing and branded content, bringing a strong point of view to client conversations, strategic recommendations, new business opportunities, and emerging creator trends.

  • Play an active role in new business efforts, contributing to RFPs, pitch development, influencer research, and presentation storytelling.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with creators, talent agencies, publishers, and platform partners to expand access to talent, industry insights, platform innovation, and strategic opportunities.
  • Bring platform fluency across both established and emerging social channels, shaping creator strategies that are native to each platform.
  • Track and distill influencer marketing trends into practical strategies that keep our work relevant, fresh, and forward-thinking.
  • Apply and evolve measurement frameworks to evaluate creator performance, campaign effectiveness, audience engagement, and business impact, translating results into actionable recommendations for clients.
  • Provide strategic guidance and quality oversight across campaign planning, creator selection, contracting, content approvals, reporting, compliance, and partnership deliverables.
  • Partner with senior leaders to identify opportunities to improve team processes, resource planning, capabilities, and approaches that support continued client and business growth.
  • Use AI, automation, and technology to elevate the quality and efficiency of work, streamline processes, and enable faster, more informed decision-making.
  • The primary focus of this role is the Influencer & Branded Content channel, ensuring excellence in strategy, execution, and performance. However, responsibilities may extend across other media channels as needed to support broader campaign objectives and business priorities.

What You Will Bring

  • 6+ years of experience in Influencer & Branded Content, including 3+ years of leadership experience, with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • You bring advanced expertise in content creation and influencer marketing strategy, developing creator-led programs that connect cultural insight, platform behavior, audience needs, and client business goals.
  • You have strong experience in contract review and proposal development, navigating creator and partnership negotiations with clarity, consistency, and a focus on delivering value for clients and partners.
  • You bring exceptional attention to detail, maintaining high standards across campaign execution, reporting, content approvals, compliance, and partnership deliverables.
  • You have strong proficiency in project implementation, leading complex influencer and branded content programs from strategic planning through launch, optimization, and post-campaign learning.
  • You are skilled in presentation and communication, delivering clear strategic narratives, senior-level recommendations, and performance insights to clients, partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • You have a deep understanding of advertising standards, client service, and relationship management, helping brands and creators build trusted partnerships that meet business, legal, and platform expectations.
  • You are proficient with influencer management dashboards, social media platforms, and the broader social media ecosystem, using data to evaluate creators, guide recommendations, and improve campaign performance.
  • You have experience building relationships across the influencer marketing ecosystem, including creators, talent agencies, publishers, and platform partners, and leveraging those relationships to strengthen client programs.
  • You bring strategic thinking, business and financial acumen, and thoughtful resource management to guide account priorities, team planning, and scalable approaches to client growth.
  • You have demonstrated experience managing and developing team members, balancing day-to-day leadership with coaching, feedback, performance management, and long-term professional development.
  • A commitment to curiosity and adaptability as a Continual Learner, staying at the forefront of media innovation while prioritizing client success with a Customer-Focused mindset that seeks opportunities to deliver meaningful value.
  • A dedication to People-Focused leadership, fostering collaboration, innovation, and professional growth by Leading by Example and nurturing strong relationships that empower others to excel.

What We Offer

This role is eligible for PMG’s annual bonus program—a standout part of our total compensation offering and an opportunity to share in our success. What Sets Us Apart

title: Instrumentation Development Embedded Engineer
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

As the Instrumentation Development Embedded Engineer, you will own the development of high-speed control and protection systems for the Alpha fusion demonstrator, focusing on FPGA-based solutions for plasma heating hardware protection.

You will work across the full development lifecycle, from writing and verifying HDL code to developing software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop testing, integrating embedded software and electronics, and establishing robust development and deployment pipelines.

You will also help establish Proxima’s FPGA development capability beyond plasma heating, defining reusable architectures, development workflows, testing methodologies, and HDL best practices that can be adopted across other systems.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Design, implement, and maintain HDL-based control and protection systems, starting with plasma heating system protection.

  • Establish end-to-end FPGA development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and SIL/HIL test environments integrated with plant design frameworks.

  • Develop embedded software, firmware, and low-level drivers to interface FPGAs with sensors, actuators, and other control systems.

  • Collaborate across RF, controls, electronics, and systems teams to define system interfaces, ICDs, and verification plans.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Degree in Electronics, Embedded Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Strong proficiency in HDL (VHDL, Verilog, SystemVerilog) and software scripting (Python, C/C++).

  • Proven experience integrating FPGAs with hardware peripherals, board-level electronics, and communication interfaces.

  • Familiarity with modern software development practices (Git, CI, code review, automated testing).

  • Systems-thinking approach with strong debugging skills spanning HDL, embedded firmware, and physical hardware.

Nice to have:

  • High-speed digital interfaces (multi-gigabit serial links, LVDS, SerDes, RF/instrumentation links) and PCB-level signal integrity.

  • FPGA+processor platforms and MPSoCs (e.g., AMD/Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+).

  • Precision timing and synchronization (IEEE 1588 PTP, White Rabbit)

  • Network protocols (Ethernet).

  • Real-time signal processing, fast protection systems, and high-speed data acquisition in fusion or industrial environments.

  • HDL design methodologies and techniques for reliable radiation-hardened systems.

  • Schematic comprehension and custom PCB development.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)


*This role sits at "L2" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

descriptionHtml:
Bei Superchat gestalten wir neu, wie Unternehmen mit ihren Kund:innen kommunizieren. KI wird dabei immer mehr zum Motor dieser Kommunikation. Integrationen sind das, was diesem Motor echte Power gibt: die Daten, Tools und Systeme, die aus einem cleveren AI-Agenten einen machen, der Prozesse wirklich automatisiert und Probleme löst.

Gegründet im Jahr 2020, ist Superchat heute die Plattform für über 10.000 Unternehmen weltweit - von bekannten Marken wie Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone und GASAG bis hin zu kleinen Unternehmen, Zahnarztpraxen und Solo-Founder:innen, die professioneller auftreten möchten.

Inzwischen laufen täglich Millionen von Nachrichten über Superchat.

Gestartet sind wir als Unified Inbox - ein zentraler Ort für alle Kommunikationskanäle wie WhatsApp, E-Mail, SMS oder Instagram. Mit dem Aufstieg von ChatGPT begann unser nächstes Kapitel: AI Agents, die über Chat, E-Mail und Voice in einer Qualität kommunizieren, die mit den besten menschlichen Teams mithalten kann.

Heute sind wir ein Team von rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, arbeiten profitabel und haben insgesamt 18 Millionen Euro Funding eingesammelt (unsere letzte Finanzierungsrunde liegt bereits 4,5 Jahre zurück - seitdem wachsen wir aus eigener Kraft weiter).

Unser Hauptsitz ist in Berlin.

Customer-facing at heart.
Du bist gerne im direkten Austausch mit Kund:innen, ob am Telefon oder im Meeting. Du hörst zu, verstehst, was dein Gegenüber braucht, und stellst dich auf jede Person individuell ein.

Explains tech in plain language.
Du kannst technische Themen so einfach erklären, dass sie auch Menschen verstehen, die nicht in der Tech-Branche arbeiten.

Hands-on, not just interested.
Du probierst ein Tool lieber aus, als nur darüber zu lesen. Wenn etwas Neues kommt, klickst du dich rein, testest herum und findest heraus, wie es funktioniert.

Takes ownership.
Du wartest nicht auf Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitungen. Du übernimmst Aufgaben, treibst sie selbst voran und stellst Fragen, wenn du sie brauchst.

Fluent German.
Du sprichst fließend Deutsch, denn die meisten deiner Kundengespräche finden auf Deutsch statt.

Who We Don’t Want

  • Du kommst nicht vom Fachjargon los - du sprichst in Anglizismen und Tech-Begriffen und tust dich schwer, dich auf eine:n SMB-Inhaber:in am Telefon einzustellen

Your Day To Day

  • Du führst Customer-Success-Meetings mit unseren Kund:innen und unterstützt sie dabei, das Beste aus den KI-Features von Superchat herauszuholen.

     

AI Operations (~20%)

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die operativen Prozesse rund um unsere KI-Features und sorgst dafür, dass alles reibungslos läuft. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Product Team zusammen und bekommst tiefe Einblicke, wie unsere AI Agents funktionieren.

Why People Choose Us

Etwas Flexibilität für Remote Work bieten wir, aber unser Default und unsere Energie liegen im gemeinsamen Office-Alltag

title: IoT Embedded Systems Engineer
descriptionHtml:
• Take ownership of the development of IoT systems, with a focus on embedded software, system architecture, and hardware and firmware integration

  • Design and develop robust, efficient, and scalable embedded software for IoT products based on microcontroller platforms and, optionally, Linux based systems

  • Provide technical guidance for hardware development in collaboration with external partners, including reviewing and challenging PCB designs to ensure functionality, quality, and manufacturability

  • Collaborate closely with mechanical, software, and cloud engineering teams to ensure seamless end to end system integration

  • Define and refine product requirements from initial concept through to mass production in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders

  • Develop and integrate prototypes and support the transition from development into serial production together with manufacturing partners

  • Contribute to the continuous evolution of the embedded platform, including MCU based solutions as well as optional Linux and Yocto based components

  • Develop pragmatic testing strategies to ensure the functionality, reliability, and quality of both hardware and firmware

  • Support development and manufacturing partners with debugging, technical documentation, and production ramp up

  • Provide Level 3 technical support for complex system, firmware, and hardware related issues

  • Travel approximately 5 to 10 percent to support development partners, product validation activities, and product launches


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience

  • Several years of hands on experience in embedded development, including firmware development and hardware related engineering

  • Strong understanding of hardware design and PCB layouts, with the ability to review design decisions and collaborate effectively with hardware development teams

  • Strong expertise in embedded firmware development and software architecture for microcontroller platforms such as ARM Cortex, ESP32, or STM32

  • Experience with sensor integration and wireless communication technologies such as BLE and WiFi

  • Experience with embedded Linux systems, particularly Yocto, is an advantage, especially in environments combining System on Modules with MCU based architectures

  • Broad system level understanding of mechanics, sensors, actuators, and their integration into robust IoT products

  • Hands on experience with hardware testing, debugging tools, and automated production testing

  • Familiarity with certification standards such as CE and FCC is an advantage

  • Fluent in German and English, with additional languages considered a plus

title: Junior Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
About EDITED

EDITED is the world’s leading AI-driven retail intelligence platform. We empower the world’s most successful brands and retailers with real-time decision making power. 

By connecting internal business and external market data, EDITED infuses intelligence into every retail decision. We help retailers increase margins, generate more sales, and drive better business outcomes through AI-powered market and enterprise intelligence that fuels automation. 

At EDITED, we foster a dynamic and inclusive culture where creativity thrives and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Our environment is dynamic and supportive, encouraging team members to take initiative, innovate, and continuously grow. We value diversity, transparency, and a shared commitment to excellence, creating a workplace where everyone's voice is heard and contributions are recognised. 

We believe that achieving a positive work-life balance is key to driving innovation and success. Our flexible working options—including hybrid working, flexible hours and a work from anywhere policy—empower our team to perform at their best. 

The Opportunity

We're seeking a motivated and curious Junior Data Scientist to join our team. In this role, you'll work alongside experienced data scientists and engineers to deliver actionable insights and build data-driven solutions across EDITED. You'll learn key methodologies, contribute to impactful projects, and develop your technical and analytical skills in a supportive environment.

What You'll Do As A Junior Data Scientist:

  • Deliver Data Science Projects: Assist in designing, building, and maintaining data science models and pipelines to solve core business problems.

  • Data Analysis & Exploration: Analyze complex datasets to extract meaningful insights, trends, and patterns supporting retail intelligence.

  • Collaborate & Learn: Work closely with senior team members, receiving mentorship and feedback to continuously refine your technical skills.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product and engineering teams to integrate data products into production systems.

  • Maintain Data Quality: Validate and clean data sources to ensure high reliability and consistency across models and reporting.

  • Communicate Findings: Present project outcomes and analytical findings clearly to team members and key stakeholders.

What You'll Bring:

  • A strong STEM degree (including Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics/Statistics, etc), or equivalent experience.

  • Solid understanding of foundational data science concepts and statistical methods.

  • Proficiency with Python and standard data science libraries (e.g. Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn).

  • Strong problem-solving ability and enthusiasm for learning new technologies.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

  • Curiosity to learn in an ever changing, fast paced environment.

What We’re Looking For In A Junior Data Scientist

It’s important for us to look for candidates that strive for excellence with a positive attitude, a strong sense of ownership and work ethic, and a passion to consistently develop and improve their knowledge and skillset. If you’re excited about the role of Junior Data Scientist and the opportunity to work at EDITED, we encourage you to apply even if you only match some, rather than all, of the requirements.

Essential:

  • 1+ years of experience (or strong academic/project background) in data analysis or machine learning.

  • Good working knowledge of Python.

  • Understanding of core machine learning concepts and statistical analyses.

What We Offer You As A Junior Data Scientist

We value our team and to attract exceptional people, we offer an excellent package! This year, we were recognised as one of the top companies to work for in the UK.

  • You can utilise our flexible working policy to ensure you can work around your schedule - this means starting & finishing when it suits you best!

  • At EDITED we are set up to work remotely

  • Enhanced parental leave policy

  • 25 days annual leave + public holidays (and an extra day for every year at EDITED)

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

  • Access to an Employee Assistance Programme

  • Gifts for work anniversaries and big life events

  • Dog friendly office

We do not use AI to source, screen, evaluate, or make decisions about candidates - every hiring decision is made by our team. We use Ashby, our applicant tracking system, which includes AI-assisted interview notetaking and automation for scheduling interviews and sending routine emails. These tools support our hiring process but do not make hiring decisions. We aim to be an equal opportunities employer and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable.

How? Through variable tariffs, dynamic pricing, smart EV charging, heat pump and solar optimization, and Germany’s first virtual power plant: NeoGrid™.

🚀 Learn By Doing: We grow together with personal development paths, learning budgets, and regular knowledge-sharing sessions. Try things out, learn along the way, and keep moving forward.

  • Probleme lösen: Wenn mal etwas nicht nach Plan läuft, kümmerst du dich um Reklamationen, klärst die Ursachen und findest gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Teams eine schnelle und faire Lösung.

  • Prozesse verbessern: Du erkennst, wo es im Alltag hakt, bringst eigene Ideen ein und hilfst uns, unseren Kundenservice kontinuierlich besser zu machen.

Bei uns geht es nicht darum, möglichst viele Tickets abzuarbeiten, sondern Kunden wirklich weiterzuhelfen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung im Kundenkontakt: Du hast idealerweise bereits im Kundenservice, in der Kundenberatung oder im Verkauf gearbeitet – gerne im Handel, E-Commerce oder einem ähnlichen Umfeld.

  • Freude an der Beratung: Du hörst zu, erkennst Kundenwünsche und hast Spaß daran, passende Lösungen und Produkte zu empfehlen.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du telefonierst gerne, schreibst verständliche E-Mails und bleibst auch bei schwierigen Gesprächen freundlich und souverän.

  • Organisationstalent: Du behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Anfragen und Bestellungen den Überblick und setzt die richtigen Prioritäten.

  • Eigeninitiative: Du denkst mit, übernimmst Verantwortung und findest lieber Lösungen, als Probleme weiterzureichen.

  • Digitale Affinität: Du arbeitest gerne mit modernen Systemen und findest dich schnell in neue Programme und Abläufe ein.

  • Teamgeist: Du arbeitest gerne mit anderen zusammen und weißt, dass guter Kundenservice nur gemeinsam funktioniert.

Vorkenntnisse in der Fenster- und Türenbranche sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wir bringen dir alles bei, was du über unsere Produkte wissen musst.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Attraktives Gehaltspaket: Starkes Fixgehalt plus Teambonus auf unsere Verkäufe – gemeinsam erfolgreich sein lohnt sich.

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag: Langfristige Perspektive in einer wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe.

  • Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben: Eine gute Mischung aus Kundenberatung, Verkauf und Auftragsbetreuung – kein Tag ist wie der andere.

  • Moderne Arbeitsweise: Digitale Prozesse, kurze Entscheidungswege und Tools, die dir die tägliche Arbeit erleichtern.

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung: Wir machen dich fit für unsere Produkte, Systeme und Abläufe. Anschließend unterstützen wir dich mit regelmäßigem Coaching.

  • 28 Tage Urlaub: Damit neben der Arbeit genügend Zeit für Erholung und Privatleben bleibt.

  • Ein Team, das zusammenhält: Offene Kommunikation, gegenseitige Unterstützung und Kollegen, die gemeinsam anpacken.

title: Lead Applied AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why loveholidays?

We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway.

Our trailblaze together culture is what drives our success, powered by our people and the way they work. Using progressive technology, we drive cutting-edge innovation and improve how our customers discover, book and experience their holidays. You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your growth through meaningful challenges, new experiences and the freedom to shape your own path. You’ll create impact for our future by taking ownership, contributing to shared goals and helping shape what comes next, all as part of our enhanced international community of talented, collaborative and passionate teams.

 

The difference you’ll make

You’ll lead the Applied AI team within the wider AI Centre of Excellence, setting technical direction and managing the engineers who build, administer and improve the AI-enabled systems and SaaS platforms that support our customers and colleagues. You’ll work closely with business verticals, engineering, security and senior stakeholders to turn business priorities into a clear roadmap and measurable outcomes.

You’ll combine people management with hands-on technical leadership across applied and agentic AI workflows, SaaS services, integrations and data pipelines. You’ll guide architecture and delivery, develop the team’s capabilities and own relationships with third-party SaaS suppliers, ensuring our platforms are reliable, secure and deliver value for money.

The team sits within Business IT & AI Operations. You’ll provide the direction, governance and operational ownership that help loveholidays scale intelligent automation and well-run business systems safely and effectively, balancing new opportunities with service quality, cost and long-term maintainability.

Your day-to-day:

  • Lead and line-manage Applied AI engineers, setting clear goals, providing regular feedback and coaching, supporting career development and managing performance. Help recruit and onboard new team members as the team grows.

  • Set the team’s technical direction and delivery roadmap with business and technology stakeholders, prioritising work, allocating capacity and managing dependencies to deliver measurable business outcomes.

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership for applied and agentic AI workflows, integrations and automation pipelines, guiding architecture, reviewing designs and code, and contributing to complex or high-impact engineering work.

  • Set standards for building, testing and evaluating tool-using agents with Google ADK or similar frameworks, including safe tool access, human oversight and production readiness.

  • Own operational performance across AI-enabled services and SaaS platforms, including service health, access, releases, usage and cost. Lead incident escalation and continuous improvement, with clear evaluation criteria and service measures.

  • Own account management for third-party SaaS suppliers, acting as the primary relationship owner and running regular service and roadmap reviews. Hold suppliers accountable for agreed service levels, resolve escalations and coordinate their delivery with internal priorities.

  • Manage the supplier and contract lifecycle with procurement, finance, legal and security, covering selection, onboarding, licensing, commercial negotiations, contractual obligations, renewals, notice dates and exit planning. Own spend management for the team’s SaaS and AI services, working with finance to forecast and manage costs against agreed budgets, explain variances and optimise licences and consumption. Track adoption, spend and value, and inform build-versus-buy decisions.

  • Establish engineering and operational standards for secure change management, documentation, runbooks and governance. Communicate progress, risks and trade-offs clearly, and ensure services have clear ownership and support arrangements.

Your skillset:

  • People & Delivery Leadership: Experience line-managing engineers, coaching and developing people, managing performance and leading delivery. Able to set direction, prioritise competing demands and build a collaborative, accountable team.

  • SaaS Supplier & Account Management: Experience owning third-party supplier relationships, service reviews, escalations, licensing and renewals. Commercial judgement and the ability to work with procurement, finance, legal and security to improve service quality and value for money.

  • SaaS Platform Ownership: Experience leading the administration and lifecycle management of cloud-based business systems, including configuration, user access, environments, integrations and releases.

  • Applied AI & Technical Direction: Strong experience delivering applied and agentic AI workflows that combine models, tools and business data, including orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation and evaluation. Able to make architecture and build-versus-buy decisions, establish engineering standards and guide others. Familiarity with Google ADK or similar frameworks is desirable.

  • Engineering & Integration: Strong hands-on engineering skills and experience designing and reviewing REST API, webhook and event-driven or scheduled integrations between SaaS platforms, AI services and backend systems.

  • Operational & Stakeholder Leadership: Experience operating production services in cloud environments, preferably Google Cloud Platform, using CI/CD, observability, incident management and secure operational practices. Able to explain technical and commercial trade-offs, influence stakeholders and connect delivery to business outcomes.

The interview journey

  • Intro with a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 30 mins

  • 1st stage video interview with the hiring manager - 1 hour

  • Applied AI technical leadership, team management and SaaS supplier management task

  • Final stage with Director of Applied AI and senior stakeholders - 1 hour

Perks of joining us:

  • Company pension contributions at 5%

  • Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up

  • Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends

  • 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum

  • Ability to buy and sell annual leave

  • Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers

 

Our commitment to inclusion

At loveholidays, we focus on creating an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute, grow and succeed. We value the different perspectives, experiences and ideas each person brings, because they help us work better together, challenge our thinking and make stronger decisions.

As we continue to grow and evolve, we want everyone to feel supported and able to do their best work. We’re also committed to making our hiring process accessible, so please let our Talent Acquisition team know if you need any adjustments at any stage.

title: Lead Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

 

About the team

 

Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good.

From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time.

  

About the role

 

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will lead high-impact AI projects and shape the technical direction of bespoke solutions. This role requires hands-on technical excellence combined with crucial team leadership.


You will define data science approaches, design robust software architectures, mentor junior colleagues, and ensure delivery rigour across projects all while building deep client relationships and solidifying our reputation as a leader in practical, measurable AI.

#LI-PRIO

  

What you'll be doing:

 

  • Leading project teams that deliver bespoke algorithms and high-stakes AI solutions to clients across the sector.

  • Conceiving the core data science approach and designing the associated robust software architecture for new engagements.

  • Mentoring a small number of data scientists and supporting the professional growth of technical team members on projects.

  • Partnering with commercial teams to build client relationships and shape project scope for technical feasibility.

  • Contributing to Faculty’s thought leadership and reputation through delivering courses, public speaking, or open-source projects.

  • Ensuring best practices are followed throughout the project lifecycle to guarantee high-quality, impactful delivery.

     

Who we're looking for:

 

  • You possess senior experience in a professional data science position or a quantitative academic field.

  • You demonstrate strong programming skills, with the ability to be a fluent Python programmer, using core libraries (NumPy, Pandas) and a deep-learning framework (e.g., PyTorch).

  • You have a deep expertise in core data science paradigms (supervised/unsupervised, NLP, validation), demonstrating a proficiency across the standard data science toolkit, including the ability to develop new, innovative algorithms.

  • You bring a leadership mindset, focused on growing the technical capabilities of the team and nurturing a collaborative culture.

  • You exhibit commercial awareness, with experience in client-facing work and the ability to translate business problems into a rigorous mathematical framework.

  • You are skilled in project planning, assessing technical feasibility, estimating delivery timelines, and leading a team to deliver high-quality work on a strict schedule.

 

Our Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Take Home Technical Assessment

  3. Technical Interview (90 minutes)

  4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Lead Database Administrator
locations: Newcastle upon Tyne, England, United Kingdom
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans.
  • Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.
  • Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).
  • Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.
  • Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking.
  • PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS).
  • OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments.
  • Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation.

Growth & Innovation:

    • Openness to learn the required technologies.
    • An interest in development, new technologies and innovation.
    • Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt.

At Partnerize, we recognise it is unrealistic for a candidate to fulfil 100% of the criteria in this job description. We encourage you to apply if you feel you meet the majority of the requirements above. We know that skills evolve over time, so if you have a keen appetite to learn and evolve alongside us over time, come join our team!

US Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
  • Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay)
  • Regular company events and activities
  • Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
  • 401k Plan – 4% employee match
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Privacy and data protection. The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. You can find further information in Partnerize privacy policy here: https://partnerize.com/privacy-policy/
