Über 450 Anwaltskanzleien nutzen den KI-Associate täglich – damit sind wir eines der am schnellsten wachsenden LegalTech-Scaleups Deutschlands: Du baust daran von Anfang an mit.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Product & Legal AI Development – Du entwickelst Silvernova gemeinsam mit unserem Entwicklungsteam juristisch-fachlich weiter: Konzeption, Validierung und Iteration agentischer Legal-AI-Workflows, Aufbau von Wissensmodellen und Qualitätssicherung der fachlichen Ergebnisse.

  • Customer Enablement – Du begleitest unsere Kanzleien mit strukturierten Onboardings, Trainings und Best Practices, damit sie schnell produktiv werden und messbaren Mehrwert sehen.

  • Markt & Insights – Du erkennst, wo Kanzleien der Schuh drückt, und bringst diese Erkenntnisse zurück ins Produkt und in unsere Go-to-Market-Strategie.

Was du mitbringst

Ein Master / LL.M. in Rechtsinformatik oder LegalTech ist ein Plus. Das Rechtsgebiet ist zweitrangig – Litigation-Erfahrung hilft.

  • Sprachen – Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, Englisch mindestens C1.

title: Legal Counsel, Product & Privacy
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

This position is remote-friendly.

⚖️ Our Legal team

The Legal team is at the heart of Joko’s growth and protection. We navigate the complexities of contracts, regulations, and risk management to ensure the company operates smoothly and seizes opportunities with confidence.

We handle all legal matters: Contracts, Corporate, Labor, Data protection, IP etc… enabling other teams to innovate with confidence.

Leveraging our expertise and external partners, we collaborate with all functions to protect Joko’s interests efficiently and proactively.

🚀 What you will do

As Legal Counsel, Product & Privacy, you will work hand in hand with our Product, Tech and business teams to make sure our product, including Juno, complies with privacy, AI, consumer and platform rules, from the PRD to the launch. You will report directly to the Head of Legal (Maya).

🔐 Privacy and AI

  • Run our GDPR programme on a centralised, cross-European basis, working closely with our DPO: records of processing, DPIAs, privacy notices, data subject requests, processor agreements and transfers.

  • Ensure compliance with non EU privacy laws as the teams grow our international activity.

  • Champion privacy by design within the product teams: show up early, ask the right questions, and help find solutions that work for users and the business.

  • Act as product counsel on Juno alongside the Product team: AI Act compliance, transparency obligations, and model and vendor terms.

🛍️ Consumer and platform rules

  • Maintain our terms of use and terms of sale with the teams who design our offers, including the cashback and gift card terms, withdrawal rights, the referral programme, and the rules of our prize draws and contests.

  • Keep Joko compliant with the expectations of the DGCCRF and its equivalents in each new country, including country-specific terms where local law requires them.

  • Own our compliance with app store and browser store rules (Apple, Google, Chrome Web Store, Firefox), together with the Security and Product teams.

  • Ensure our compliance with the terms of our affiliate networks, with the teams who manage these partnerships.

💳 Banking and payments regulation

  • Map the regulatory perimeter of each business line and each new market (payment and e-money regimes, gift cards) with the teams building them and our external specialist counsel.

  • Monitor whether each business line stays within its current status as the product evolves.

💡 How the scope is covered. We don't expect you to be an expert in all of these areas. Privacy and AI are the core of the role; consumer law and platform rules can be learned on the job if they're new to you, and we rely on external counsel in needed.

🙌 Who you are

  • You have 4 to 6 years of experience in data protection, including time in a top-tier law firm or as in-house product or privacy counsel.

  • You have worked with product and tech teams, and you can read a PRD or a data flow and identify the issues it raises.

  • You follow AI regulation closely and you have already advised on AI products.

  • Experience in consumer law is a plus; a CIPP/E or equivalent certification is a plus.

  • You hold a Master's degree in IP/IT law, data protection law or business law from a leading French law school. Admission to the Paris Bar is a plus.

  • You are fluent in French and English.

  • You give clear and actionable answers to non-lawyers, and you know when a risk is acceptable.

  • You are curious about AI and want to learn how to build the tools that change legal work.

What we tell you upfront. Until the three poles are staffed, every Legal Counsel works across the full legal scope with the Head of Legal. Functional ownership is formalised as soon as the Commercial & IP and Product & Privacy seats are both filled.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €65K – €95K • Offers Equity

title: Leiter Operations (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unternehmen

Die Hoffmann+Voss GmbH ist Teil der PolymerCycle Gruppe und spezialisiert auf die Regranulierung und das Recompounding technischer Kunststoffe. Die Hoffmann+Voss GmbH liefert ihre Produkte an höchst anspruchsvolle Kundenindustrien – wie die Automobilbranche, Elektro-/Elektronik oder Haushaltsgeräte – zuverlässig und nach strengen Qualitätsanforderungen. Dafür greift die Hoffmann+Voss GmbH auf langjährige Erfahrung in der Aufbereitung und Compoundierung von technischen Kunststoffen zurück. Mit einem vollumfänglichen, modern ausgestatteten Labor bietet Hoffmann+Voss umfassende Analytik-, Prüf- und Entwicklungsleistungen.

In der Gruppe bündeln die Unternehmen der PolymerCycle Gruppe ihren Zugang zu unterschiedlichen Rohstoffströmen, ihre Expertise in komplexen Kundenindustrien, umfangreiche Produktionskapazitäten sowie tiefes technologisches und materialwissenschaftliches Know-how. Durch die Kombination von Sortier-, Trenn-, Regranulierungs- und Compounding-Know-how entstehen hochwertige Recyclinglösungen, die sowohl technische Anforderungen erfüllen als auch die wachsende europäische Nachfrage nach qualitätsgesicherten Rezyklaten bedienen.

Für das Werk der Hoffmann+Voss GmbH in Viersen suchen wir einen Leiter Operations (m/w/d).

Aufgaben & Verantwortung

  • Gesamtverantwortung für den operativen Betrieb des Werks – einschließlich Produktion, Instandhaltung, Lagermanagement und Logistik sowie Arbeitssicherheit und nachhaltiger Ressourcennutzung
  • Führung, Entwicklung und Organisation des Produktionsteams sowie Sicherstellung einer effizienten Personaleinsatz- und Schichtplanung
  • Steuerung und kontinuierliche Optimierung der Produktionsprozesse für Regranulierung und Recompounding – von vom Wareneingang über die Zerkleinerung und Aufbereitung bis hin zur Extrusion
  • Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung von Produkten, Prozessen und Technologien
  • Verantwortung für Kennzahlen, Maßnahmen zur Produktivitätssteigerung sowie Initiierung und Umsetzung von Verbesserungsprojekten nach Lean- und KVP-Prinzipien
  • Budget- und Kostenverantwortung einschließlich Investitionsplanung, Wirtschaftlichkeitsbetrachtungen und laufendem Kostencontrolling
  • Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Qualitäts-, Umwelt- und Arbeitsschutzanforderungen

Qualifikationen

  • Technische Ausbildung oder Studium – beispielsweise in Kunststofftechnik, Verfahrenstechnik, Maschinenbau oder Produktionstechnik
  • Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung in einem produzierenden Unternehmen, idealerweise in der Kunststoffverarbeitung oder im Recycling
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Produktionsmanagement, Prozessoptimierung, Lean-Methoden und Qualitätsmanagement
  • Solides betriebswirtschaftliches Verständnis – Kostenrechnung, Budget- und Investitionsplanung
  • Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägter Hands-on-Mentalität, sicherem Auftreten sowie der Fähigkeit, Mitarbeitende zu motivieren und Veränderungen wirksam umzusetzen
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie ein sicherer Umgang mit MS Office und ERP-Systemen

Wir bieten

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle Schlüsselposition in einem wachsenden, zukunftsorientierten Markt mit direktem Einfluss auf die weitere Entwicklung des Standorts
  • Großer Gestaltungsspielraum – Prozesse weiterentwickeln, Strukturen schaffen und Verbesserungen im Werk unmittelbar umsetzen
  • Zusammenarbeit in einem dynamischen, interdisziplinären Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und engem Austausch innerhalb der PolymerCycle Gruppe
  • Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und Entwicklungsperspektiven innerhalb der Gruppe
  • Ein sicherer, langfristig angelegter Arbeitsplatz mit leistungsgerechter Vergütung, attraktiven Benefits und einem modernen Arbeitsumfeld mit hochwertiger technischer Ausstattung

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

You’ll run a strong operating cadence across customer engagements — including kickoffs, success planning, executive business reviews, adoption reviews, and renewals — helping customers translate product usage into measurable business outcomes and clear ROI.

You will proactively manage customer health, identify risks before they become blockers, and drive resolution across technical and business stakeholders. In addition, you’ll help design scalable playbooks and programs that improve customer outcomes across the broader customer base.

Working closely with Support, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Sales, you’ll turn technical success into durable revenue growth by driving adoption, renewals, and expansion opportunities that contribute to strong enterprise net revenue retention.

What You’ll Be Doing

📊 Value & outcomes mindset: You’re comfortable translating product usage into measurable business outcomes, ROI, and executive-ready narratives.

🧭 Operational rigor: You run a structured operating cadence, manage competing priorities effectively, and keep stakeholders aligned with strong follow-through.

🗣 Clear, high-trust communication: You communicate clearly with both technical builders and executive stakeholders, and you’re known for building durable customer relationships.

🤝 Cross-functional collaboration: You partner effectively with Sales, Support, Solutions Engineering, and Product to unblock customers and improve the customer journey.

🌱 Builder mindset in ambiguity: You thrive in fast-moving environments, take ownership, and enjoy building processes as the company scales.

Nice-to-haves

🚀 Startup/scale-up experience: You’ve operated in high-growth environments and enjoy “building the plane while flying it.”

title: Manager, Architecture
descriptionHtml:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Technology practice are looking for an experienced Architecture Manager to join the team. 

In Technology, we help clients define, drive and deliver technology-led change. We have deep experience in the strategy, design, delivery and assurance of large-scale transformation across financial services, energy, commodities, utilities, telecoms and government. Our people become trusted advisors, independent of any technology provider, and deliver real value for our clients.

AI is changing how organisations work, compete and invest, and it’s changing architecture with it. Our clients need architects who can cut through the hype, turn ambition into practical action and create value without losing control of cost, risk or complexity.

In our Architecture practice we bring the right balance of innovation, pace and control to technology-enabled change. We work on our clients’ most complex and highest-return challenges. Commodity or ivory-tower architecture isn’t where we play.

As a Manager, you’ll lead architecture work, use AI to raise the pace and quality of what we deliver, and play an active part in growing our business. You’ll spot opportunities, shape compelling work and build relationships that last well beyond a single engagement.

What you will be doing

Lead architecture that delivers real value

You’ll lead architecture work that turns strategy into practical change. That means owning architecture engagements and workstreams, shaping target architectures and roadmaps, and helping clients make better decisions about where to invest, what to simplify and how to manage risk.

  • Lead engagements with clear ownership of scope, quality, outcomes and client relationships
  • Help organisations improve their architecture functions, operating models and governance
  • Communicate complex ideas clearly, from delivery teams through to CTOs and CIOs

Help clients navigate AI-enabled change

You’ll help clients move from interest in AI to safe, valuable adoption. We’ll look to you to cut through the noise, design for change and make sure AI-enabled solutions have the foundations they need: data, integration, security, identity, governance and clear ownership.

  • Shape AI-ready architectures that balance innovation, pace and control
  • Help clients move beyond disconnected pilots to reusable services, governed delivery and measurable value
  • Use AI tools to speed up research, analysis, option development and architecture artefacts, with strong quality assurance throughout

Create and convert commercial opportunities

You’ll play an active part in growing our business. That means spotting where we can help, shaping work that clients value and building the confidence to convert good conversations into deliverable opportunities.

  • Qualify opportunities through delivery, market insight and trusted relationships
  • Shape proposals, statements of work, team shapes and commercial models with discipline
  • Build architecture propositions that match our growth priorities and the challenges our clients face

Lead people and build our capability

You’ll help build the kind of team people want to work in and clients want to work with. You’ll coach others, share what works and help us turn individual expertise into reusable capability across the practice.

  • Lead mixed Baringa and client teams with clear expectations and a strong coaching mindset
  • Coach colleagues on effective and responsible use of AI
  • Help grow the practice through training, thought leadership, reusable assets and recruitment

 
Your skills and experience  

  • Experience leading architecture work within complex technology-enabled change, with a strong delivery focus
  • Experience in both enterprise and solution architecture, translating strategy into deliverable target architectures and roadmaps, and designing and assuring solutions to achieve it
  • Broad experience across architecture domains (business, application, integration, data, infrastructure and security), with deep expertise in at least one
  • Cloud experience across XaaS offerings, with knowledge of cloud-native services and how to use them in cloud and hybrid solutions
  • A practical understanding of AI and the architecture considerations needed to adopt it safely and at scale. Hands-on AI design experience is a bonus, not a must
  • Experience contributing to proposals, bids or account growth, and the commercial awareness to shape work that is valuable and deliverable
  • The ability to take ownership of projects and teams, sell work and deliver results
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain the complex in simple terms, concisely and with clarity
  • Experience managing stakeholders from C-suite through to engineering, and a desire to build lasting relationships
  • A collaborative style, real curiosity and a genuine interest in helping others grow 

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.

Baringa Privacy Notices

For UK & EU

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our UK Recruitment Privacy Notice / EU Recruitment Privacy Notice, to evaluate your application and meet our legal and reporting obligations. In line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to request access to, rectification, or erasure (subject to legal limitations) of your personal data. title: Manager / Associate Director, Corporate Tax Advisory
descriptionHtml:
The Role

Join the UK’s market leading Financial Advisory Restructuring Tax team and make a real difference on a range of high profile and dynamic transactions. Our Financial Advisory Restructuring Tax team specialises in providing tax advice on the restructuring of financially distressed businesses. They have built a fantastic track record in recent years, leading on some of Europe’s largest and most complex restructuring processes. These include debt restructuring transactions, debt-for-equity swaps, business reconstructions via Restructuring Plans, Schemes of Arrangement and CVAs, and insolvency appointments. The variety of work really stands out, as does the friendly and supportive nature of the team. The team has a great mix of UK and international transactions work and is looking to recruit a corporation tax specialist at Associate Director level to build on the existing business capability and target a number of exciting developments in the restructuring market. This role is primarily advisory focused but will have some compliance responsibility. This is a unique opportunity to get involved. The role is technically interesting and personally rewarding.

Key Responsibilities

Your key areas of focus will include:

  • Working directly with our financial advisory colleagues and external stakeholders including lenders, borrowers and legal advisors to understand the often complex commercial and legal requirements of each restructuring transaction;
  • Developing a strategy for achieving the commercial aims in a tax efficient manner.

title: Manager CTO Office
descriptionHtml:
Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en we willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Manager CTO Office rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO en geef je leiding aan circa 16 IT-professionals. Het CTO Office is het centrale regie- en ondersteuningsorgaan binnen het CTO-domein.

Vanuit het team zorg je ervoor dat het Technology - domein aantoonbaar in control is, met geïntegreerde sturing op onder andere governance, risk, performance, change portfolio en Third Parties.

Samen met je team zorg je voor betrouwbare, veilige en klant- en businessgerichte Technology-dienstverlening. Je bouwt aan een professionele, resultaatgerichte werkomgeving waarin continu leren, talentontwikkeling, vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en continu verbeteren centraal staan.

Als Manager CTO Office heb je een sleutelrol binnen het MT Technology en rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO. Je verbindt leiderschap en strategisch inzicht met een pragmatische aanpak. Zo zorg je voor samenhangende sturing en beheersing van het Technology-domein, waarbij governance en control bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming en een effectieve IT-organisatie.

Sturing en beheersing
Je ontwikkelt en implementeert een integrale visie op governance en control, waarmee Athora effectief voldoet aan interne en externe verplichtingen en tegelijkertijd ruimte creëert voor innovatie en groei. Je geeft richting aan governance, quality & risk management, procesmanagement, compliance, performance management, service management en demand & delivery management. Daarbij stuur je actief op kwaliteit, voorspelbaarheid en continue verbetering, zodat managementbeslissingen gebaseerd zijn op heldere inzichten en meetbare resultaten.

Verandering en verbetering
Je ontwikkelt en bestuurt het change portfolio voor het CTO-domein. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om de organisatie slimmer, eenvoudiger en effectiever te laten werken en zorgt dat veranderingen bijdragen aan de strategische doelen van Athora.

Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Je leidt het CTO Office, ontwikkelt talent en versterkt vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en een professionele, resultaatgerichte cultuur;

  • Je stuurt het Technology changeportfolio aan en zoekt daarbij actief de verbinding met de betrokken Change & Agility managers en de centrale portfoliofunctie;

  • Je ontwikkelt en verbetert de IT-governance: je verduidelijkt verantwoordelijkheden, versterkt de besluitvorming en geeft richting en waarborgt aansluiting tussen Technology Governance en Data & AI Governance belegd bij het Data & AI Office;

  • Je borgt samen met de relevante stakeholders kwaliteit, risicobeheersing en compliance binnen Technology;

  • Je bereidt namens Technology de overleggen voor met toezichthouders zoals DNB, de externe accountant, Internal Audit en tweedelijns controlefuncties;

  • Je voert de regie over Third Party Risk Management en waarborgt dat risico's, prestaties en compliance van strategische IT-sourcingpartners effectief worden beheerst;

  • Je ontwikkelt en bewaakt de sourcingstrategie en het outsourcingbeleid. Ook organiseer en bewaak je de governance en monitoring van kritieke uitbestede activiteiten;

  • Je levert heldere operationele, tactische en strategische stuurinformatie en versterkt daarmee transparante besluitvorming en een sterke performancecultuur.

  • Je bewaakt budgetten, beheerst kosten en maakt de financiën binnen Technology en de onderliggende dienstverlening inzichtelijk;

  • Je coacht en geeft functioneel leiding aan Product Owners, Release Train Engineers en Scrum Masters binnen Technology.


Wat vragen we van jou?

Voor deze rol zoeken we een ervaren manager die overzicht weet te houden in een complex Technology-landschap en tegelijkertijd dicht genoeg op de uitvoering zit om daadwerkelijk verandering te realiseren.

Dit breng je minimaal mee:

  • WO-werk- en -denkniveau en een relevante opleiding, bij voorkeur in informatiemanagement, IT, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Minimaal 10 jaar relevante ervaring binnen de financiële dienstverlening, met een sterk trackrecord op het gebied van strategisch advies, Governance, IT-governance, IT-procesmanagement, quality & risk control en performance-, service- en demand & delivery management;

  • Ruime ervaring met het aansturen, ontwikkelen en inspireren van teams van vergelijkbare omvang, waarbij je medewerkers in staat stelt het beste uit zichzelf te halen;

  • Diepgaande kennis van IT4IT, COBIT en andere toonaangevende IT-standaarden en frameworks, en het vermogen deze effectief toe te passen in een complexe organisatieomgeving;

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met SAFe-principes en Agile werken, inclusief incrementplanning, sprintcadans, backlogmanagement en het succesvol managen van afhankelijkheden tussen teams;

  • Sterke verandermanagementvaardigheden, waarbij je strategische ambities vertaalt naar concrete initiatieven en blijvende resultaten realiseert;

  • Uitstekende stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief samen te werken met senior management, Legal & Compliance, Risk, Internal Audit en externe accountants;

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels, mondeling en schriftelijk.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega’s die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.

Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.

In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.

Op basis van cao schaal 19 HAY is de range € 7.872,85 tot € 10.497,13 op basis van 36 uur.

title: Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering
descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is building the team to help the world's most ambitious organizations adopt Claude in ways that are transformative, safe, and lasting. Our Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with strategic customers to ship production AI applications that solve real business problems. As this practice grows, we need a founding leader to build and scale it.

As the first FDE Manager in DACH, you'll own the team that sits at the frontier of enterprise AI deployment. You'll hire and develop a high-performing team of FDEs, set the technical and operational bar for customer engagements, and build the playbooks that turn one-off successes into repeatable patterns. You'll work hand-in-hand with Engagement Managers who own delivery logistics and stakeholder management, while you ensure your team is shipping quality code, growing technically, and representing Anthropic at the highest level in customer environments.

This is a player-coach role with a strong bias toward leadership. You'll stay close enough to the technical work to review architectures, debug production issues, and pair with your team when it matters — but your primary impact will come from the people you hire, the standards you set, and the culture you create. You'll partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Engineering to shape how Anthropic serves its most strategic customers, and your team's field insights will directly influence product direction.

This role requires someone who thrives in ambiguity and is energized by building from zero to one. You'll be defining what good looks like for FDE management at Anthropic — there is no existing playbook to follow.

Responsibilities

  • Hire, develop, and retain a world-class team of Forward Deployed Engineers. Set a high bar for technical talent and customer instincts.

  • Conduct regular 1:1s, provide technical mentorship, and invest in the career growth of each team member. Create an environment where FDEs do the best work of their careers.

  • Staff and oversee customer engagements across your team's portfolio, making resource allocation decisions that balance customer needs, team development, and business priorities.

  • Collaborate with account teams and Engagement Managers during the pre-sales process to qualify engagements, scope work, and inform statements of work.

  • Review technical architectures and code produced by your FDEs, ensuring the team ships high-quality, production-ready solutions that solve real customer problems.

  • Stay hands-on enough to lead technical discovery sessions, prototype solutions, and debug complex issues alongside your team when needed.

  • Build repeatable playbooks, starter repositories, integration templates, and an internal knowledge base that captures what your team learns in the field.

  • Define team OKRs that tie to customer success outcomes and product adoption goals. Create operational cadences — standups, retros, engagement reviews — that keep the team aligned.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to translate field insights into product improvements. Serve as the voice of the customer in internal planning.

  • Travel to customer sites as needed (25-50%), particularly during engagement kickoffs and for your team's highest-priority accounts.

You may be a good fit if you have

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, or a technical customer-facing role such as forward deployed engineering or consulting.

  • 2+ years of people management experience within a services/post-sales/FDE organization with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.

  • Experience building organizations from 0->1, not just inheriting an existing one.

  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers on technical implementations, including comfort navigating complex organizational dynamics.

  • Executive presence with the ability to move fluidly between strategic conversations with senior stakeholders and hands-on debugging sessions with engineers.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. You can translate technical complexity into clear narratives for diverse audiences.

  • Genuine excitement about building something new and defining what great looks like for a team that doesn't yet exist.

Why this role matters

You'll be a founding leader of a team that defines how enterprises adopt and scale AI. Your work will directly influence Anthropic's product direction, create reusable patterns for the broader customer base, and establish Anthropic as the trusted partner for AI transformation — all while advancing the responsible development of frontier AI systems.

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Husky is what we call the distributed, petabyte-scale columnar event store at the heart of our Event Platform, which powers dozens of Datadog’s most popular products – Logs, RUM, APM, Cloud Network Monitoring, Netflow, and many more. title: Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Vestlane

Vestlane ist die Plattform für Onboarding, KYC/AML und Tax Compliance für Private-Market-Fonds. Fondsmanager und Fondsadministratoren in ganz Europa wickeln über Vestlane ihre KYC-, AML- und Zeichnungsprozesse ab, in über 14 Jurisdiktionen und über den gesamten Investor-Lifecycle hinweg. Wir sind zertifiziert und für die regulatorische Realität spannender Akronyme gebaut – von GwG, BaFin, AMLR, RTS, CSSF bis hin zu DORA, RAIF, AIFMD, MiFID uvm.

Du hast schon ein paar Jahre B2B-Marketing gemacht und willst jetzt Kanäle wirklich verantworten statt nur zuzuarbeiten? Du willst die Welt von Venture Capital und Private Equity von innen kennenlernen, ohne selbst in einem Fonds zu sitzen? Du kannst schreiben, denkst in Zielgruppen statt in Posts und findest es reizvoll, aus GwG und CSSF-Rundschreiben Inhalte zu machen, die Compliance-Verantwortliche tatsächlich lesen? Du betreibst Marketing mit KI-Tools und Daten statt mit der Gießkanne? Dann ist diese Rolle für dich!

Als Marketing Manager arbeitest du direkt mit unserem COO zusammen, der Go-to-Market verantwortet, und in enger Abstimmung mit unserem CEO. Du übernimmst die Marketing-Themen, die heute auf seinem Tisch liegen – von Content und SEO über LinkedIn und Newsletter bis Website und Events – und bist nah dran an jeder Entscheidung, die unsere Positionierung bewegt. Kolleg:innen aus Regulatory, Design und Customer Success liefern dir Fachwissen, Grafiken und Kundenstimmen. Echte Verantwortung für eigene Kanäle ab Tag eins, kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung, keine Agenturschleifen. Dein Arbeitsplatz ist unser Office in Bonn, mit flexiblen Home-Office-Regelungen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Content, der gelesen wird: Du planst und schreibst Blogartikel, Landingpages und Fachbeiträge zu KYC/AML, AMLR, Fondsregulierung und unseren Produktfeatures – auf Deutsch und Englisch, fachlich sauber, verständlich und mit Haltung.

  • SEO und GEO verantworten: Du baust auf unseren bestehenden Rankings auf, entwickelst die Keyword-Strategie weiter und sorgst dafür, dass Vestlane auch dort gefunden wird, wo heute gesucht wird.

  • LinkedIn und Newsletter fahren: Du bespielst die Company Page, bereitest Posts für die Geschäftsführung vor und verantwortest unseren Regulatory- und Product-Newsletter von der Themenplanung bis zum Versand.

  • Website weiterentwickeln: Du pflegst und erweiterst vestlane.com in unserem CMS (Storyblok), briefst Design, testest neue Seiten und misst, was funktioniert.

  • Success Stories und Events: Du sammelst Kundenstimmen gemeinsam mit Customer Success, machst daraus Case Studies und verantwortest das Pre- und Post-Marketing von Events, Webinaren und Partner-Announcements.

  • Die Marketing-Maschine bauen: Du strukturierst Contentplanung, Tracking und Reporting, baust KI-Workflows für Recherche, Entwürfe und Distribution und zeigst mit Zahlen, welche Maßnahmen Pipeline bringen.

Dein Profil

  • 1 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing, idealerweise SaaS, Finanz- oder Legal-/RegTech-Umfeld. Du hast schon mindestens einen Kanal eigenständig verantwortet (Content, SEO, LinkedIn oder Newsletter) und kannst zeigen, was dabei herausgekommen ist.

  • Du schreibst sehr gut auf Deutsch und Englisch: klar, präzise, ohne Buzzword-Nebel. Du kannst einen komplexen Sachverhalt in drei Sätzen erklären und in einem Post zuspitzen.

  • Solide SEO-Kenntnisse (Keyword-Recherche, On-Page, Content-Struktur, Tracking) und echtes Interesse an Generative Engine Optimization. Erfahrung mit einem CMS, LinkedIn Company Pages und einem Newsletter-Tool.

  • Du nutzt KI-Tools im Alltag selbstverständlich für Recherche, Entwürfe und Analysen und weißt, wo du selbst nachschärfen musst.

  • Du magst Zahlen: Du willst wissen, ob dein Artikel rankt, ob der Newsletter geöffnet wird und was davon im CRM ankommt.

  • Interesse an Finanzregulierung und Compliance. Du musst kein GwG-Profi sein, aber du musst Lust haben, dich einzuarbeiten – Fachwissen bekommst du von Kolleg:innen, die täglich damit arbeiten.

  • Du siehst dich als Unternehmer:in innerhalb von Vestlane, nicht als Content-Lieferant:in. Du willst heute Verantwortung und morgen Führung, und du willst dir beides erarbeiten, indem du etwas aufbaust.

Deine Benefits

  • Eigene Kanäle und Themen ab Tag eins, mit klarem Entwicklungspfad hin zu mehr Verantwortung im Marketing

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit COO und CEO, kurze Entscheidungswege, keine Agenturschleifen

  • Vollzeit, unbefristet, Start ab sofort möglich

  • Kompetitives Gehaltspaket

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Bezahlte Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen

  • Arbeitsplatz in unserem Bonner Office, flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home-Office-Regelungen

  • Moderne Tools und KI im täglichen Einsatz

  • Ein Team, das Compliance ernst nimmt, weil Compliance das Produkt ist, kein Kostenfaktor

Abschluss

Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und zwei bis drei Arbeitsproben (Artikel, Posts, Landingpages, Newsletter – was zeigt, wie du arbeitest). Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht; ein paar Sätze dazu, warum Marketing für ein RegTech dich reizt, reichen. Wir prüfen deine Bewerbung persönlich und melden uns innerhalb von zwei Wochen.

Der Prozess ist bewusst kurz und hat drei Schritte: ein 30-minütiges Kennenlerngespräch, in dem es um dich, deinen Weg und die Frage geht, ob wir zueinander passen. Dann ein 45-minütiger Termin mit einer praktischen Aufgabe aus dem echten Alltag – zum Beispiel ein LinkedIn-Post zu einem regulatorischen Thema –, damit du siehst, was dich erwartet, und wir sehen, wie du arbeitest. Zum Abschluss ein 30-minütiges Gespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Insgesamt weniger als zwei Stunden deiner Zeit, und du bekommst nach jedem Schritt zeitnah Rückmeldung.

Fragen vor der Bewerbung? Melde dich bei uns!

title: Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
Why Verifone

For more than 40 years Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide.

Verifone has a diverse, dynamic and fast paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in the fact that we work with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third party partners to invent and deliver innovative payments solution around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services, and are obsessed with customer happiness. Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it’s developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives each one of our employees for personal and professional success.

Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located. Currently, we do allow a hybrid work schedule but we regularly revisit our attendance policy.

What's Exciting About The Role

We’re searching a Marketing Manager to execute Verifone’s marketing strategy in France and play a pivotal role in accelerating our growth in one of Europe’s most dynamic payments markets.

As the Marketing Manager, you’ll be the engine behind France’s marketing performance: building the systems, dashboards, and processes that power smarter decisions, stronger campaigns, and measurable commercial impact. You’ll lead both day‑to‑day execution and long‑term strategy, ensuring our brand, messaging, and demand generation efforts land with precision.

You’ll own the full marketing funnel - from awareness and acquisition to retention and installed‑base growth and you’ll bring hands‑on expertise in marketing automation, lead nurturing, and multi‑channel campaign orchestration. Email, digital, content, events… you know how to blend them into high‑performing programs that generate qualified leads and fuel sales momentum.

This role carries clear accountability: hitting France’s lead targets, elevating lead quality and conversion, enriching data, automating processes, and delivering sharp reporting across programs and channels. Your work will directly influence pipeline, performance, and ROI.

Key Responsibilities 

  • Design, manage and implement marketing programs and strategies for Verifone France and Paybox
  • Manage and update the Verifone Regional websites (Including Paybox): website maintenance, supervising the creation and development of websites, including creating specification documents to improve the website and other online projects
  • Manage the advertising campaigns and the relationship with the agency, including creating lists of keywords that define campaigns, creating and testing ads/banners specific for targeted verticals, set-up and monitor end to end lead tracking (sources/channels)
  • Obsess about results: analyze site traffic and website flows, conversion optimization campaign results, analyze and report program performance; report metrics appropriately and flag issues for internal stakeholders, provide recommendations for improvement
  • Propose new marketing strategies and implement new ideas that can improve overall funnel performance, from brand awareness to client retention
  • Design and manage email nurture flows and/or drip programs for both prospects and existing customers to support sales growth and retention, and implement the tracking of these flows
  • Work closely with multiple teams for developing an effective strategy and new programs

Skills and Experience We Desire

  • Native French speaker with advanced English proficiency
  • Degree in marketing, business, or a related field, with strong foundations in modern digital marketing
  • 5+ years of experience leading integrated, multi‑channel marketing campaigns across digital, content, email, and events
  • Hands‑on mastery of key platforms, including marketing automation tools (Pardot, Marketo, etc.), CRMs such as Salesforce or Pipedrive, Google Analytics, social platforms (Facebook, Instagram), and email marketing systems
  • Advanced analytical capability to manage complex lead lifecycles, optimize funnel performance, and extract insights from data
  • Strong project management skills to coordinate cross‑functional initiatives and deliver high‑impact marketing programs
  • Up‑to‑date knowledge of industry trends, emerging technologies, and modern marketing best practices
  • SEM‑focused copywriting skills to craft compelling, conversion‑driven search content
  • Working knowledge of HTML for landing page and email optimization
  • Expert‑level Excel skills, including large dataset handling and macro‑based automation

Soft skills:

  • Proactive in suggesting new concepts/ideas, self-motivated, fast learner
  • Customer-oriented and problem-solving attitude (use analytical and creative thinking to find solutions)
  • Results-oriented, great attention to detail, openness to testing and analyzing large volumes of data
  • Communication: ability to cooperate and work fairly with others, at all levels, within and outside the company
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and work under tight deadlines when necessary

Our Commitment

Verifone is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Verifone is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

title: Meewerkstage Berenschot-COT Instituut voor Veiligheids- en Crisismanagement
descriptionHtml:
0,8-1 fte | Utrecht | Hybride | Veiligheids- en crisismanagement | € 600,– | Wo

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Ben jij een wo-student die gefascineerd is door veiligheid, crisismanagement en complexe maatschappelijke vraagstukken? Vind je de theorie boeiend, maar kun je niet wachten om de praktijk te ervaren? Wil je meedraaien in een team dat adviseert bij ingrijpende incidenten en organisaties voorbereidt op het onvoorspelbare? Dan is een stage bij Berenschot-COT iets voor jou!

Tijdens deze meewerkstage draai je als volwaardige collega mee in het hart van het veiligheidsdomein. Je werkt aan opdrachten voor ministeries, veiligheidsregio’s en private organisaties. Van het analyseren van cyberaanvallen tot het ondersteunen bij grootschalige crisisoefeningen: jij maakt écht het verschil.

Dit ga je doen

Als stagiair bij Berenschot-COT werk je onder begeleiding van een ervaren projectleider samen met collega’s aan diverse projecten binnen het veiligheids- en crisisdomein. Je bent actief betrokken bij zowel trainingen en oefeningen als onderzoeks- en adviesopdrachten.

Je draagt onder andere bij aan:

  • het ontwikkelen en voorbereiden van trainingen en crisisoefeningen, waaronder het opstellen van oefenscenario’s en trainingsmateriaal

  • het ondersteunen bij de uitvoering van trainingen en oefeningen, inclusief observatie en evaluatie

  • het uitvoeren van onderzoeks- en adviesopdrachten voor uiteenlopende inhoudelijke thema’s binnen crisismanagement

  • het verzamelen en analyseren van informatie

  • het bijwonen van bijeenkomsten en verzorgen van verslaglegging

  • het meewerken aan (calamiteiten)onderzoeken

Daarnaast neem je deel aan interne overleggen, kennissessies en teamactiviteiten. Zo leer je niet alleen het vakgebied goed kennen, maar ook de dynamiek van werken in een professioneel adviesbureau.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid vanaf dag één krijg je de kans om te ontdekken waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Berenschot-COT is gespecialiseerd in advisering, onderzoek, trainingen en oefeningen op het gebied van veiligheids- en crisismanagement. Wij adviseren organisaties vóór, tijdens en na crisissituaties en helpen hen hun crisis- en veiligheidsmanagement structureel te verbeteren.

Berenschot-COT heeft brede ervaring binnen zowel de publieke als private sector, in binnen- en buitenland. Opdrachten die landelijke bekendheid kregen zijn onder meer het onderzoek naar het schietdrama in Alphen aan den Rijn, de tramaanslag in Utrecht, de ongeregeldheden rond Ajax-Maccabi Tel Aviv en de cyberaanval bij de TU Eindhoven. Voor meer informatie en recente opdrachten zie: www.cot.nl.


Dit neem je mee

We zoeken een gemotiveerde wo-student (laatste jaar bachelor of master) met affiniteit voor crisis- en veiligheidsvraagstukken. Denk qua studieachtergrond bijvoorbeeld aan communicatie, media, politicologie, bestuurskunde, security studies of criminologie. Andere relevante opleidingen zijn uiteraard ook welkom, mits je motivatie aansluit bij ons werkveld.

Daarnaast:

  • je kunt zelfstandig werken en functioneert goed binnen een team

  • je bent communicatief vaardig en presenteert je professioneel, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk

  • je hebt een sterk analytisch vermogen

  • je bent beschikbaar voor een stageperiode van vijf of zes maanden voor vier of vijf dagen per week (maximaal 38,75 uur)

  • startmomenten zijn maart (t/m juli) of september (t/m februari).

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot-COT werk je in een professionele en maatschappelijk betrokken adviesomgeving met veel ruimte voor initiatief en ontwikkeling. Je kunt rekenen op:

  • een uitdagende meewerkstage van vijf of zes maanden

  • een stagevergoeding van € 600,– per maand (op fulltimebasis)

  • een laptop

  • flexibele werkmogelijkheden, ook thuis

  • regelmatige feedback- en check-in momenten met je stagebegeleider

  • een platte organisatie waarin je écht iets kunt betekenen

  • een gezellig team dat werk en plezier goed weet te combineren.

Stageplusprogramma

Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Dit vraagt gemiddeld één dagdeel per twee weken. Via deze link lees je meer over het programma. Alles over ons stageplusprogramma | Berenschot

Solliciteer meteen

Wil jij ook een trotse Berenschotter worden? Je kunt tot 1 juli reageren. Solliciteer direct! Vragen? Neem contact op met Vicky Schats, via WhatsApp (06-25 72 26 12) of per e-mail (). Vergeet in je motivatie niet te vermelden voor welke periode je een stage zoekt en hoeveel uur per week je beschikbaar bent. Dan kunnen we je sollicitatie zo goed mogelijk beoordelen.

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Na je sollicitatie ontvang je binnen een werkweek een reactie. Bij een positieve eerste indruk nodigen we je uit voor een kennismaking met collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Als dat goed aansluit, ontvang je een concreet aanbod.

Warum diese Rolle?

Die IT-Infrastruktur soll jetzt Schritt für Schritt sauber aufgestellt werden. Rollen, Gruppen und Gruppenrichtlinien sind über die Zeit entstanden und brauchen eine klare Ordnung. Zugleich soll der Tenant alle Standorte sauber abbilden, und der weitere Rollout von Microsoft 365 in die Organisation steht an.

  • Weil Sie Ihre Vorstellung eines sauberen Tenants einbringen und die Verantwortung dafür tragen.

  • Weil Sie die Roadmap für den weiteren Rollout von Anfang an prägen.

  • Weil am Ende ein Backend steht, auf das sich das Unternehmen beim Wachsen verlassen kann.

Das sind Ihre Aufgaben

  • Sie ordnen Rollen, Gruppen und Berechtigungen neu: Gruppen zusammenführen, Namenskonventionen festlegen, ein Rollenkonzept mit RBAC und Privileged Identity Management aufbauen, bei Bedarf mit Administrative Units je Land.

  • Sie bauen Intune als Plattform für die Geräteverwaltung aus: Autopilot, Softwareverteilung, Compliance-Richtlinien sowie Smartphones und Tablets.

  • Sie setzen Sicherheitsgrundlagen im Tenant um, darunter Defender-Basisschutz in Abstimmung mit dem externen SOC, und halten Lizenzen und Admin-Konten sauber.

  • Sie betreuen Exchange Online, Teams und SharePoint auf technischer Ebene.

  • Sie planen den weiteren Rollout von Microsoft 365 mit, bringen ihn in die Organisation und halten Standards schriftlich fest.

Zur Einordnung: Die Rolle verantwortet das technische Backend von Microsoft 365, also Tenant, Identitäten, Berechtigungen, Richtlinien und Sicherheit. Sie konzipieren und setzen selbst um. Dabei arbeiten Sie im Infrastruktur-Team eng mit den Kolleginnen und Kollegen an den Standorten in Europa und Nordamerika zusammen.

title: Mixed-signal Verification Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

As Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer you will own the methodology, planning, and execution of mixed-signal verification for digital-to-analog interfaces on Arago's Systems-on-Chip, working across analog, RTL, architecture, and firmware teams to ensure correct integration and drive verification to sign-off.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience in ASIC or SoC verification.

  • Experience verifying mixed-signal blocks or digital-to-analog and analog-to-digital interfaces.

  • Experience with AMS (analog-mixed-signal) co-simulation flow, and setting up mixed-signal testbenches.

  • Strong SystemVerilog skills and practical experience with UVM or an equivalent verification methodology.

  • Experience building verification environments and developing tests, assertions, scoreboards, and functional coverage.

  • Good understanding of both digital design fundamentals and basic analog/mixed-signal concepts.

  • Strong debugging skills, including the ability to investigate issues spanning RTL, models, clocks, resets, configuration, and analog behavior.

  • Experience with scripting and automation, preferably Python, Tcl, shell, or similar.

  • Language: English at a proficient level.

Responsibilities

  • Own the mixed-signal verification methodology and verification plan for digital-to-analog interfaces on Arago SoCs.

  • Build and maintain verification environments at block, subsystem, and SoC level.

  • Develop tests, assertions, checkers, scoreboards, and functional coverage.

  • Verify digital control and configuration of analog/mixed-signal circuitry across normal operation, corner cases, and error conditions.

  • Run regressions, analyze coverage, debug failures, and drive verification to sign-off.

  • Develop or integrate behavioral and real-number models needed for efficient mixed-signal simulation.

  • Work closely with analog, RTL, architecture, firmware, and SoC verification teams to identify and resolve interface issues.

Nice to have

  • Verification experience with complex high-speed interface IP such as PCIe, DDR/LPDDR, UCIe, SerDes, USB, CXL, or similar PHY-based interfaces.

  • Experience verifying interface initialization, link training, calibration, adaptation, clocking, power-state transitions, or other digital/analog control loops.

  • Experience with real-number modeling, SystemVerilog RNM, wreal, Verilog-AMS, or equivalent mixed-signal verification techniques.

  • Experience developing or integrating behavioral models of analog/PHY components into digital verification environments.

  • Experience with SoC-level integration and verification of complex interface IP.

  • Experience with low-power verification, power-state management, or UPF.

  • Experience driving a complex IP or SoC verification effort through coverage closure and tape-out.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of AI at Arago.

title: Mobile Application Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Mobile Application Engineer

The Role

Lyrebird’s product lives or dies in a single moment: a clinician starting a consultation and trusting that every word is being captured. Today, that moment happens in the browser. As our first Mobile Application Engineer, you’ll take ownership of bringing Lyrebird to iOS and Android, starting with the capability that matters most: reliable audio capture on a phone. You’ll own the mobile application end to end, from the build pipeline and store releases to bringing our core web features into a native experience that works in the real conditions clinicians face every day.

This role suits someone who enjoys being the person who owns the whole thing. You’re comfortable moving between native platform APIs and a TypeScript codebase, you care about the unglamorous details (permissions, interruptions, flaky networks), and you get satisfaction from shipping something that simply works when it matters. You’ll enjoy the autonomy of shaping a platform from its early days, and the responsibility of building for people who can’t afford for their tools to fail mid-consultation.

About Us

Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians’ most time-consuming tasks.

Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. Everything we build is grounded in earning trust, reducing cognitive load, and delivering meaningful impact at scale.

What you’ll do

  • Implement and own the mobile build pipeline, producing signed iOS and Android builds and keeping configuration current

  • Release the app to the App Store and Google Play, managing versioning, phased rollouts, and store review

  • Deliver mobile audio capture for consultations, handling microphone permissions, background recording, and interruptions such as incoming phone calls

  • Make audio uploads resilient on poor networks, with retry and resume built in

  • Bring mature web features into the mobile app, matching their behaviour and resilience whilst adapting the experience for small screens

  • Optimise reporting and telemetry, then use what you learn to make the app more stable

  • Build and maintain the mobile test suite and run it as part of the build pipeline

  • Keep across platform changes from Apple and Google and plan the work they require

What you’ll bring

  • Strong experience in cross-platform development (React Native). Preferable to also have experience in Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin.

  • Hands-on experience with mobile audio capture, including background audio, interruption handling, and microphone permissions (for example AVAudioSession, AudioRecord, or MediaRecorder in a WebView)

  • Experience automating mobile builds and releases with tools such as Expo (EAS), Xcode Cloud, or Gradle, including code signing and phased rollouts on both stores

  • Confidence in TypeScript and the ability to read and change a SvelteKit web codebase

  • Experience with mobile test automation using Browserstack.

  • Experience integrating mobile apps with REST APIs

Nice to have

  • Experience with Progressive Web Apps, including service workers, web app manifests, and offline caching

  • Experience setting up mobile crash reporting and telemetry with Sentry or similar

  • A working knowledge of on-device data protection, such as encryption at rest and short data retention

  • Familiarity with Sveltkit and Typescript backend frameworks

  • Familiarity with AWS and Terraform

  • Experience building software for healthcare or other regulated environments

Every minute a clinician spends on admin is a minute taken away from a patient. Putting Lyrebird in a clinician’s pocket means it can be there on a ward round, in a community visit, or anywhere care actually happens. You’ll be building the foundation that makes that possible, and your work will be felt directly by clinicians and the patients in front of them.

We’re building a team that reflects the diversity of the people who benefit from our work. We want Lyrebird to be a place where everyone feels safe, supported, and able to thrive. If you’re from an underrepresented background in tech, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

title: Offre de Stage ou Service Civique 6 mois
descriptionHtml:
Communication, Événementiel & Engagement sportif chez Undrtd Sport

Vos missions

Qui sommes-nous ?

Undrtd Sport est une association à but non lucratif qui utilise le sport comme levier d’émancipation sociale, professionnelle et personnelle.

Notre mission : promouvoir la culture basket en France tout en développant des projets à impact, inclusifs et inspirants.

Nous croyons au pouvoir du sport pour rassembler, ouvrir des opportunités et révéler les talents.

Nous portons plusieurs programmes :

  • Lady Boss : empowerment des jeunes femmes à travers le sport, la formation et des rôles modèles.
  • Young Boss : job dating sportifs pour connecter jeunes et recruteurs sur les playgrounds.
  • Podcast & storytelling : mettre en lumière les trajectoires inspirantes issues du monde du sport.

Nous collaborons avec des acteurs comme Ball’N Connect, la ville de Villiers-le-Bel, Snipes ou encore le PSG.

Vos compétences

Tu intégreras une équipe jeune, passionnée et engagée, et tu participeras activement à :

💡 Communication & Création de contenu

  • Rédaction de contenus pour les réseaux sociaux, newsletters et supports partenaires
  • Participation à la ligne éditoriale : storytelling, mise en avant des profils inspirants, reporting d’événements

🎤 Événementiel & Projets terrain

  • Aide à l’organisation d’événements sportifs & inspirants (Boss du Playground, Young Boss Day…)
  • Mobilisation des bénévoles et coordination des parties prenantes
  • Suivi logistique des actions de terrain

🤝 Partenariats & Impact

  • Appui à la relation avec nos partenaires publics et privés
  • Participation à la structuration de notre impact social (indicateurs, bilan, documentation)

Avantages

🎯 Expérience professionnelle enrichissante

  • Mission polyvalente : communication, événementiel, partenariats, impact social.
  • Responsabilités concrètes dès le début, avec des tâches variées (rédaction, logistique, relations partenaires).
  • Opportunité d’évoluer rapidement dans une structure dynamique.

🧠 Développement de compétences

  • Rédaction de contenu, storytelling, gestion de projet.
  • Maîtrise d’outils pro : Canva, Notion, Insta, et éventuellement photo/vidéo.
  • Communication professionnelle (partenaires publics/privés, bénévoles).

💥 Projet à impact

  • Association à but non lucratif engagée pour l’émancipation sociale via le sport.
  • Participation à des projets concrets et inspirants : Lady Boss, Young Boss, podcasts, etc.
  • Travail aligné avec des valeurs fortes : inclusion, égalité, empowerment, culture urbaine.

🤝 Environnement stimulant

  • Équipe jeune, passionnée et engagée.
  • Réseau de partenaires influents : Snipes, PSG, Ball’N Connect, collectivités locales…
  • Événements riches en rencontres : playgrounds, job dating, podcasts, témoignages inspirants.

🌍 Flexibilité et cadre bienveillant

  • Télétravail partiel possible.
  • Indemnisation légale selon statut (stage ou service civique).
  • Accès à un réseau et à un écosystème en pleine croissance.

✨ Valorisation personnelle et professionnelle

  • Possibilité de mettre en avant ses projets créatifs ou son Insta à la place d’un CV classique.
  • Autonomie encouragée : tu peux proposer des idées, documenter le terrain, créer du contenu original.
  • Tu représentes une cause valorisante, ce qui peut booster ton profil pour de futures opportunités (dans le sport, le social ou la communication).

Tu veux rejoindre un projet humain, engagé et en plein essor.

Tu veux faire bouger les lignes à travers le sport, avoir un vrai impact et progresser vite dans un cadre bienveillant.

Undrtd Sport. L’émancipation par le sport.

title: Online Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Online Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - Vollzeit | München | Festanstellung

Im Auftrag unseres Partnerunternehmens in München suchen wir Sie zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als „Online Marketing Manager (m/w/d)“.

Aufgaben

  • Als Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d) verantworten Sie das gesamte Inhouse-Performance-Marketing einschließlich der strategischen Planung und operativen Umsetzung
  • Zudem entwickeln und optimieren Sie Kampagnen auf Kanälen wie Google Ads, Meta, Display und Affiliate und steuern die entsprechenden Marketingbudgets
  • Darüber hinaus planen und koordinieren Sie saisonale Marketingaktionen, Verkaufsaktionen und Produktlaunches in enger Abstimmung mit den Grafik- und Content-Teams
  • Zusätzlich betreuen und optimieren Sie das Tracking- und Feedmanagement einschließlich Tracking-Links, Pixeln und Produktfeeds
  • Dabei analysieren Sie relevante Performance-Kennzahlen, erstellen regelmäßige Reportings und leiten gezielte Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab

Qualifikation

  • Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Marketing, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder E-Commerce oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung
  • Sie bringen mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d), Online Marketing Manager (m/w/d) oder Digital Marketing Manager (m/w/d) mit
  • Sie besitzen fundierte Kenntnisse im Kampagnenmanagement, in der Budgetsteuerung und in der Analyse relevanter Marketing-KPIs
  • Zusätzlich verfügen Sie über Erfahrung mit Performance-Marketing-Kanälen wie Google Ads und Meta sowie fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
  • Wichtig sind analytisches Denken, Kommunikationsstärke, Teamfähigkeit und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität

Benefits

  • Work-Life-Balance: Freuen Sie sich auf flexible Arbeitszeiten im Gleitzeitmodell
  • Sicherheit: Unbefristete Jobmöglichkeit im Rahmen der Direktvermittlung
  • Gesundheit: Ergonomische Arbeitsplätze sowie zahlreiche Sport- und Gesundheitsangebote sorgen dafür, dass Sie sich rundum wohlfühlen
  • Entwicklung: Auf Sie warten zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Vielseitigkeit: Freuen Sie sich aufspannende und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld

Sie finden das Stellenprofil interessant? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung. Für Rückfragen steht Ihnen Simon Schneider gerne unter 089 954 287 111 zur Verfügung.

title: Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: Germany · Munich
Employment Type: Full-time

Join Us at the Ground Level of Something Big

Are you ready to help shape the future of clean energy from day one? This is more than just a job—it’s a rare opportunity to build the foundation, culture, and direction of a new company. If you’re eager for a dynamic role where your ideas and initiative truly matter, we invite you to be one of our first pioneers.

Responsibilities

  • Build, customize, and maintain infrastructure toolchains. Lead operations automation and intelligent operations initiatives.

  • Investigate technical challenges and resolve complex incidents. Ensure production systems remain secure, stable, and efficient. Provide 24/7 on-call support for production issues.

  • Operate and maintain business systems on public cloud platforms, including AWS and Azure. Resolve system stability issues in production.

  • Write operations documentation and runbooks. Develop operations strategies and standards.

  • Handle cloud security alerts, compliance audits, and related security operations work.

  • Deploy, release, and manage configuration changes for NVT software.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science or a related field, with at least five years of DevOps or system operations experience. Cloud certifications such as Alibaba Cloud ACP or AWS Certification are preferred.

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS and Microsoft Azure operations. Familiar with cloud compute, networking, and database services, including EC2/ECS, VPC, NAT, Aurora, and ElastiCache. Strong troubleshooting skills are required.

  • Familiar with cloud-native container platforms such as ACK and EKS, as well as big data technologies including Flink, Spark, StarRocks, and related ecosystems.

  • Strong understanding of Linux systems and administration. Proficient in Shell scripting. Experience with Python, Golang, Java, Vue, or React is preferred.

  • Familiar with CI/CD processes and tools such as Jenkins, GitLab, Maven, and Nexus.

  • Fluent in English, with the ability to communicate effectively in daily work settings;understanding of Chinese is a strong plus.

  • Strong sense of responsibility and ownership, with a high level of respect for production environments.

  • Experience using AI tools to improve operations efficiency, or experience operating and maintaining large language model infrastructure, is preferred.
