As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Rightmove will never discriminate based on age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender reassignment, marriage / civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity or sexual orientation. 

At Rightmove, we believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce leads to better innovation, productivity, and overall success. We are committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of their background or identity, to develop and promote a diverse culture that reflects the communities we serve.

title: Senior Digital Learning Experience Designer, Learning & Inclusion
descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Embedded (ARM) Engineer - Quantum Computing (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future.

We are looking for a Senior Embedded (ARM) Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen and own the real-time firmware that turns our control electronics into a working quantum computer. You will work on our next-generation system, where the control electronics are being integrated into a single, highly integrated chip. You sit at the heart of the machine, between the hardware that generates the pulses and the higher-level software that describes the experiments. Timing is not a detail here; it is the product. You are the person who makes sure the right signal reaches the ions at the right nanosecond, reliably, run after run.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the embedded firmware on our ARM-based control platform, from architecture through implementation to on-hardware debugging

  • Develop and maintain the real-time software layer that coordinates pulse sequencing, timing, and data flow across our highly integrated control chip

  • Write and maintain the low-level drivers and board support the hardware relies on

  • Guarantee deterministic, low-latency behaviour under hard real-time constraints

  • Lead firmware bring-up together with our electronics and physics teams, and debug at the boundary where software meets signal

  • Define the firmware architecture and engineering practices — build, test, and release processes for the embedded layer as the system matures

  • Contribute to the interfaces between the embedded layer and the rest of the stack, so experiments defined in software run correctly on the machine


Required Skills:

  • 5+ years of professional embedded software development for real-time or timing-critical systems

  • Deep command of C (and ideally C++) on ARM platforms, working close to the hardware

  • Experience with bare-metal and/or RTOS environments, and a clear understanding of when each is appropriate

  • Comfortable reading schematics and datasheets, and debugging real hardware with oscilloscopes, logic analysers, and JTAG

  • Strong grasp of real-time concepts: interrupts, DMA, timing, concurrency, and determinism

  • A track record of bringing up firmware on new hardware, not only maintaining existing systems

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with experimental physicists and engineers, and to turn imprecise physical requirements into robust firmware

  • Strong adaptability and a quick learning mindset

  • Good proficiency in English (written and spoken)

Nice to have (Bonus)

  • Experience on highly integrated SoCs, particularly ARM+FPGA platforms such as Xilinx Zynq / RFSoC

  • Working alongside FPGA/digital-electronics engineers at the software–gateware boundary

  • Rust for embedded systems

  • Embedded Linux on ARM (Cortex-A), including driver and kernel-module work

  • Signal processing or control-loop implementation on embedded targets

  • Experience with high-speed data acquisition or precision timing systems

  • Familiarity with laboratory, scientific, or measurement instrumentation

  • Prior experience with quantum computing or other deep-tech domains


What you can expect from eleQtron:

  • Competitive salary: We value our team members and therefore provide remunerations that reflect this, additionally rewarding achievements

  • Flexible working hours: We offer personal freedom through a variety of flexible work schedules

  • Team spirit: In our international and diverse team, and with our regular team events, having fun at work is simply part of the culture

  • Further development: We want to grow together and so we offer our team members needs-based, individualized further training as well as plenty of room for personal development

  • Wellness Package: We offer health-promoting benefits such as fitness programs like UrbanSportsClub to support your well-being

  • Bike Leasing: Stay Mobile and Sustainable with Our Company Bike Leasing Program

  • Moving Benefits: A warm welcome! We are happy to support employees who move for us with a bonus

  • At the forefront: Work at the forefront of technology, where academic research meets commercial applications

  • Modern workplace: We have a high-quality infrastructure with laboratory space, offices and meeting rooms

title: Senior Fleet Manager
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een vooruitdenker die complexe data moeiteloos vertaalt naar glashelder advies? Neem jij van nature de regie, ben je sterk in stakeholdermanagement en heb je affiniteit met de dynamische wereld van Schiphol? Lees dan snel verder!

Binnen Orion Fleet Management zijn we op zoek naar een proactieve Senior Fleet Manager met een specifieke focus op onze klant Schiphol en ons label AirportPartners. Waar een reguliere Fleet Manager sterk leunt op de dagelijkse operatie, sta jij als Senior Fleet Manager daarboven. Jij kijkt verder dan de waan van de dag, anticipeert op wat komen gaat en gebruikt keiharde data om onze klant op strategisch niveau te adviseren.

Wat ga je doen?

In de rol van Senior Fleet Manager ben jij de absolute eigenaar van de vlootbeschikbaarheid voor Schiphol. Met ons label AirportPartners beheren wij hier de unieke en bedrijfskritische vloot van Schiphol: van de brandweerwagens en de onmisbare sneeuwvloot tot de personenwagens van het KLM-personeel. Jouw werk draait niet om achteraf reageren, maar om proactief sturen. Omdat jij de operationele basis feilloos begrijpt en beheerst, kun jij de vertaalslag maken naar optimalisatie en strategisch partnership.

Jouw takenpakket als Senior Fleet Manager bestaat uit de volgende pijlers:

Datagedreven Regie & Strategie:

  • Proactieve advisering: Je wacht niet tot de klant belt met een probleem, maar je adviseert hen ongevraagd over rendementsverbetering en risicobeperking op basis van jouw data-analyses;

  • Datagedreven regie: Je gebruikt voorspellende data om de vloot optimaal in te zetten en stilstand te minimaliseren. Vooruitdenken is jouw tweede natuur;

  • Bewaking van SLA’s en KPI’s: Je monitort continu de prestaties, stuurt bij waar nodig en garandeert dat we onze beloftes aan de klant waarmaken (of overtreffen);

  • Rapportage en overleg: Je zit regelmatig aan tafel met het management van klanten en leveranciers. Je presenteert heldere rapportages en treedt op als een volwaardig en strategisch gesprekspartner.

Operationele Excellentie:

Om op strategisch niveau te kunnen adviseren, zorg jij dat de basisprocessen, de motor van de afdeling, vlekkeloos verlopen:

  • Triage en analyse: Je overziet de storingsmeldingen en zorgt voor een feilloze initiële beoordeling.

  • Slimme planning: Je overziet de planning van (preventief) onderhoud, altijd met de impact op de 24/7 luchthaven operatie en veiligheid op Schiphol in je achterhoofd;

  • Toetsing en beoordeling: Je beoordeelt complexe reparatie aanvragen kritisch op basis van historie, vastgelegde afspraken en toekomstige inzet van het voertuig;

Wat vragen we van jou?

Voor de rol van Senior Fleet Manager zoeken we iemand die stevig in zijn of haar schoenen staat. Je overziet het grote geheel, maar snapt de details die de data beïnvloeden. Verder zien wij graag het volgende terug:

  • Denkniveau: Je beschikt over HBO of WO werk- en denkniveau;

  • Sterk analytisch: Je bent een kei in het analyseren van data en haalt hier moeiteloos de juiste conclusies en actiepunten uit;

  • Proactieve mindset: Je wacht niet af, maar signaleert kansen en knelpunten voordat ze een probleem vormen;

  • Kennis & Ervaring: Je snapt hoe onderhoudsprocessen (triage, MTTR, MTBF) werken. Ervaring als Fleet Manager is een must en ervaring in de automotive of specifiek de OV-sector (bussen) is een zware pré;

  • Overtuigingskracht: Je hebt uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden. Je kunt draagvlak creëren en complexe technische of data-gerelateerde zaken begrijpelijk uitleggen aan directie, klanten en leveranciers.

Ben jij klaar voor deze stap als Senior Fleet Manager en wil je bouwen aan de toekomst van ons wagenparkbeheer op Schiphol? Druk dan snel op de sollicitatieknop en laat jouw cv en motivatie achter!

Wat bieden wij

Een leuke en uitdagende baan met veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid. Je komt te werken in een professionele en stabiele kantooromgeving. Orion is een sterk groeiend bedrijf binnen de Pon-onderneming en biedt doorgroeimogelijkheden in de toekomst.

Wat bieden we nog meer voor de functie van Senior Fleet Manager:

  • Een goed salaris tussen de € 4.579,- en € 6.538,- o.b.v. fulltime. Uiteraard is dit afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 28 vakantiedagen* en 6 ADV dagen;

  • Een individueel keuzebudget (o.a. te besteden voor het aankopen van verlof);

  • Directe en korte lijnen; je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Teamlead Operations;

  • De mogelijkheid om deels thuis te werken;

  • Een enthousiast, gezellig, compact en ambitieus team;

  • Een ruime Pon-pensioenregeling;

  • Een collectieve ziektekostenverzekering bij ONVZ of Zilveren Kruis waarbij Pon €300 per jaar bijdraagt;

  • Pon Fit: sportieve activiteiten waar je aan kan deelnemen! Van bootcamp tot golfclinic;

  • Korting op eigen producten van Pon (bijv. een nieuwe Gazelle fiets of privé lease auto), €500 per jaar;

  • Lease-a-bike regeling voor het leasen van een Pon-fiets.

Over de organisatie

Orion ontzorgt bedrijven met grote complexe wagenparken door het reparatie- en onderhoudsproces optimaal te structureren.

Binnen het netwerk heeft Orion een 15-tal eigen werkplaatsen onder de labels: AirportPartners, BusPartners en WastePartners. Onze werkplaatsen zijn gevestigd in: Almere, Amersfoort, Badhoevedorp-Schiphol (2 locaties), Ede, Emmeloord, Helmond, Leeuwarden, Leiden, Lichtenvoorde, Middelburg, Montfoort, Oosterwolde, Utrecht en Zwolle. Deze vacature is gericht op ons hoofdkantoor in Barneveld!

Met circa 250 collega’s zetten wij ons dagelijks in om ervoor te zorgen dat onder andere huis en bedrijfsafval opgehaald kunnen worden, vliegtuigen kunnen blijven opstijgen en landen en OV-reizigers in veilige en betrouwbare bussen kunnen reizen. Wij staan midden in de maatschappij en spelen in op trends als verstedelijking, elektrificatie, duurzaamheid en digitalisering.

Iedereen is welkom !

descriptionHtml:

As a Front End Engineer, you will play a key role in our Aircraft Domain team, being responsible for building sleek, responsive, and user-friendly interfaces to enable real-time control and monitoring of our mission aircraft and their related systems.

While this role focuses on the development for the P19 and related aircraft, your work is conducted in close collaboration with the core development team, which drives the whole swarm robotics and sensor control distributed over multiple domains. Your work will directly contribute to the usability and efficiency of our cutting-edge robotics solutions.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Design, develop, and optimize frontend applications for controlling and visualizing robotic swarms and sensor data.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Front-end Focus - Growth
descriptionHtml:
🚀 About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with a front-end focus who has experience working with commercial. You’ll turn a marketing campaign, a pricing test or a new product launch into a fast, reliable experience, then measure whether it worked.

Your main focus will be zoe.com and our acquisition and conversion journeys, including landing pages, checkout, sign-up and product launches across our app subscriptions and physical products. You’ll spend most of your time in TypeScript, React and Next.js, and you’ll work in our backend services (Kotlin or Python) whenever a feature needs it.

This is a senior individual contributor role. We’re looking for someone who works autonomously, makes sound decisions independently and takes full ownership of their work.

💻 Our Stack

  • Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js, React, GraphQL

  • Backend: Kotlin / Spring Boot, Python / FastAPI and Django

  • Tools: DatoCMS / headless CMS, Optimizely / AB testing tools, Grafana, Sentry, Firebase Auth

  • CI/CD: ArgoCD, GitHub Actions

  • Data: web data layer, dbt, BigQuery

  • Infrastructure: GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, Vercel

👥 About the Team

You’ll join ZOE’s Growth team, which drives how people discover, learn and become a member. Growth sits where engineering meets the commercial side of the business. We work closely with marketing, CRM, product, design and analytics to turn ideas into experiments, and experiments into results.

Our wider Engineering team is a distributed across the UK and EU, with skills spanning web, mobile and backend engineering, machine learning, data science and analytics. We’re proud of the diversity in our team: 39% female and 61% male, with colleagues from many backgrounds, cultures and lived experiences. We believe this makes us stronger, more creative and better able to serve our global community.

Above all, we value curiosity, openness and empowerment. We encourage everyone to share ideas, keep learning and shape how we work.

🎯 What you’ll be doing

  • Owning growth initiatives end to end: from shaping the idea with commercial partners, through technical delivery, to measuring the result.

  • Partnering with commercial teams: working day to day with marketing, CRM and product to deliver campaigns, launches and acquisition journeys, often to tight, business-critical deadlines.

  • Running experiments: designing, launching and analysing A/B tests with our analysts, and using the results to decide what to build next.

  • Building a fast, high-converting zoe.com: owning web performance, accessibility and conversion across key journeys such as landing pages, sign-up and checkout.

  • Adapting to changing priorities: making pragmatic trade-offs when plans change, and helping the team decide what to build, what to defer and what to drop.

  • Working across the stack: shaping APIs and making backend changes where growth features need them, in Kotlin or Python.

  • Contributing to the design system: helping grow our shared component library so the team can ship consistent experiences quickly.

  • Shipping continuously: releasing to production daily, often more than once, with the testing and monitoring in place to do so safely.

🧠 We think you’d be great if you…

  • Have 5+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on front-end.

  • Have strong experience with TypeScript, React and Next.js, and know how to build fast, accessible and well-tested web experiences.

  • Have worked closely with commercial functions such as marketing, growth, sales or CRM, and enjoy turning business goals into product outcomes.

  • Have hands-on experience with experimentation and analytics, such as A/B testing, conversion optimisation or funnel analysis.

  • Work autonomously: you take ownership of ambiguous problems, make decisions with limited guidance and keep stakeholders informed.

  • Have working knowledge of a backend language (such as Python, Kotlin or Java) and are comfortable making backend changes.

  • Have worked in a startup or scale-up environment and are comfortable with a fast pace and shifting priorities.

✨ Nice to have

  • Experience with Optimizely or similar experimentation tools

  • Experience in e-commerce, subscriptions or direct-to-consumer growth

  • Experience building or contributing to a design system

  • React Native experience, or interest in growth across web and mobile

  • Production experience with Kotlin or Python

🌍 Where and how we work

  • This is a permanent, full-time employed position.

  • Fully remote, open to candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Spain or Germany who have the permanent right to work there. We’re not able to offer visa sponsorship.

  • We work across UK and Central European time zones, with core collaboration hours. We get together in person once a quarter for team offsites at our London office, and once a year for a company-wide retreat.

✨ Our Hiring Journey

We value your time. While the exact steps and timeline can vary slightly depending on the role, seniority, and team, we’ve designed a streamlined 4-step blueprint to get us from "Hello" to "Welcome to the team" as efficiently as possible:

  1. 👋 Intro Chat with the Talent Team: A high-energy alignment check to learn about you and share our vision.

  2. 🧠 Hiring Manager Interview: A tactical conversation focused on your craft, experience, and aspirations.

  3. 🔄 The Remote Loop: 2 to 4 focused interviews assessing your technical expertise, behavioural approach, and collaboration style.

  4. 🎉 Offer & Welcome: Finalising the details and getting you ready to hit the ground running!

Once we connect, we pride ourselves on moving fast. Our average hiring process takes between 20 to 30 days, depending on the complexity of the role.

We love momentum, but we’re always happy to adjust the timeline to match your schedule and personal preference.

___________________________________________________________________________

🚀 Ready to thrive? Apply Now

If you are genuinely excited about ZOE's mission and this opportunity, please don't hesitate to apply—even if you don't meet every single requirement listed. We fundamentally value potential and commitment above all else.

ZOE is an equal opportunity employer. If you require any reasonable accommodations during the interview process, just let us know—we are here to support you.

Not the perfect match? Join ZOE's Talent Community!

If this role isn't the exact right fit, or the timing isn't right, don't let the journey end here. Drop your resume here. When a role opens up that matches your unique superpowers, you'll be the first person we reach out to.

title: Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) – PHP/Symfony & React
descriptionHtml:
Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring für unseren Kunden die Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.

Auf einen Blick

  • Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD

  • Gehalt: 52.000–62.000 € brutto/Jahr, für außergewöhnliche Profile auch mehr · unbefristet, Vollzeit

  • Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote

  • Standort: Berlin

  • Produkt: Eine Software für Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement in der öffentlichen Verwaltung

  • Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung

Die Rolle

Das Kernprodukt unserer Kunden ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen

  • Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen

  • Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln

  • Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen

  • Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden

  • Zwei Auszubildende im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)

  • Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Nach 6 Monaten …

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für die Auszubildenden eine feste Ansprechperson.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)

  • PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID

  • Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework

  • Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.

  • JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab

  • Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL

  • Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD

  • Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1

  • Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch

  • Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter.

  • Abschluss: Ausbildung oder FH-Abschluss zählen genauso viel wie ein Uni-Studium. Entscheidend ist deine Praxiserfahrung.

Pluspunkte: REST/API-Design und Schnittstellenentwicklung, automatisiertes Testing (PHPUnit, Jest), Docker, Deployment-Pipelines und Cloud, Software-Architektur und Design-Patterns, produktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder Codex. Erfahrung mit Software für den öffentlichen Sektor ist nicht nötig.

Dein Team

Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: ein Developer Lead, ein Geschäftsführer und Projektmanager, der selbst aktiv mitentwickelt, ein externer Entwickler und zwei Auszubildende. Ihr stimmt euch täglich ab. Die Entwicklungsleitung und die Geschäftsführung übernehmen dein Onboarding persönlich.

Was wir bieten

  • Ein sinnstiftendes Produkt, das täglich in Bürgerämtern genutzt wird, in einem krisensicheren Markt

  • Echter Einfluss auf technische Entscheidungen und eine Modernisierung mit klarem Ziel

  • 30 Urlaubstage

  • Gleitzeit mit Kernzeit ab 10 Uhr, 2 Remote-Tage pro Woche

  • Weiterbildung während der Arbeitszeit, Udemy-Kurse; eigene Vorschläge sind willkommen

  • Claude-Lizenz, offen für weitere Tools

  • Hardware: Lenovo ThinkPad, offen für Vorschläge

  • UrbanSportsClub und JobRad

  • Gute Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess

  • Kennenlerngespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team

  • Technisches Interview mit Live-Projektarbeit mit dem Developer Lead und der Geschäftsführung

  • Teamgespräch vor Ort

  • Angebot

Über das Unternehmen

Unser Kunde entwickelt seit über 25 Jahren Software für die öffentliche Verwaltung. Städte wie Berlin, München, Bonn und Dessau setzen seit Jahrzehnten auf die Lösungen des Unternehmens.

title: Senior Growth Director (Commercial Lead)
descriptionHtml:
About Moloco:

Moloco is an AI-native performance advertising company, bringing the power of AI advertising to the open internet. Founded in 2013 by machine learning engineers who had built AI advertising systems inside the world's largest technology companies, Moloco began from a shared mission: to build that same engine for the open internet.

Today, Moloco is one company with two businesses, built on the same compound AI system. Moloco Ads is our AI-native performance advertising platform, helping mobile app marketers acquire, retain, and re-engage high-value users across the open internet. Moloco Commerce Media is our AI-native retail media platform, enabling retailers and marketplaces to turn their platforms into thriving ad businesses. Both are powered by CARA (Compound Ad Recommendation Architecture), the AI system behind every Moloco product.

At Moloco, we bring together those who've already solved hard problems and those with the drive to. Here, we work on some of the complex problems in AI advertising, at a scale and level of sophistication very few companies can offer. Come build what's next.

The Impact You’ll Be Contributing to Moloco:

Join Moloco as a Senior Growth Director and lead the strategic growth of some of our most important partners across EMEA. As a senior individual contributor, you will own a dedicated portfolio of top accounts, building executive partnerships and developing commercial strategies that create lasting value for customers and Moloco.

You will bring a deep understanding of each customer’s business, connect their priorities to Moloco’s capabilities, and lead our most complex commercial conversations. Your impact will extend beyond your own portfolio through selective support on high-stakes opportunities, coaching, and influencing Moloco’s product and commercial direction.

The Opportunity:

Based in London, you’ll operate as a Commercial Lead within the EMEA Growth team, accountable for substantial revenue outcomes and long-term customer growth. This is an individual contributor role combining hands-on account ownership with commercial leadership across the wider team.

Strategic Growth & Commercial Ownership

  • Own and deliver revenue targets across a dedicated portfolio of top EMEA accounts, with accountability for forecast accuracy, risk management, and long-term growth.
  • Set and drive the multi-year growth agenda for your customers, leading joint business planning with executive stakeholders to secure investment commitments, establish shared accountability, and drive delivery against ambitious commercial goals.
  • Unlock incremental revenue through expansion into new geographies, business units, use cases, and product adoption.
  • Own the most complex and ambiguous commercial negotiations across your portfolio, structuring non-standard agreements in partnership with Sales, Finance, Legal, and leadership to balance customer value, commercial risk, and sustainable growth.

Consultative Selling & Executive Partnership

  • Act as a trusted commercial advisor and industry expert to your customers, combining deep knowledge of their business models and company goals with insight into market dynamics and competitive trends to challenge assumptions, shape growth strategies, and identify where Moloco can create lasting business value.
  • Develop tailored proposals grounded in customer business outcomes, including lifetime value, payback period, and return on ad spend at scale.
  • Build long-term strategic partnerships with customers, independently owning C-suite and senior commercial relationships and aligning Moloco’s role in their growth with shared objectives, investment priorities, and measures of success.
  • Use trusted executive relationships to shape customer priorities, influence investment decisions, and unlock growth opportunities beyond existing campaigns—including opening doors to new decision-makers, business units, and markets.
  • Lead executive business reviews and strategic planning conversations, translating performance data into clear recommendations for long-term growth.

Product Expertise & Cross-Functional Influence

  • Apply deep knowledge of Moloco’s products, machine learning capabilities, and the mobile advertising ecosystem to shape credible solutions for customers.

title: Senior Information Security Infrastructure Engineer - Security Architecture - InfoSec
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role :

Join the InfoSec - Security Architecture team as a Senior Information Security Infrastructure Engineer, where you'll have the chance to play a key role in protecting our organization's data and systems. This position offers the opportunity to work on meaningful projects that directly impact our security posture and collaborate with a skilled team passionate about information security.   In more details: We ingest the security telemetry that the whole security org runs on. In this role you'll get that telemetry into Elasticsearch consistently and keep the underlying Elastic clusters healthy. You own the pipeline end to end: from a new security data source landing, through ingest pipelines, into the indices detection, IR, and consulting teams query, plus the clusters that store it all. 

What You Will Be Doing :

  • Security telemetry ingestion - build and maintain ingestion of security-relevant data into Elasticsearch (cloud provider audit logs, identity/SaaS activity, endpoint and asset data). This means integrating with third-party and cloud provider APIs to pull telemetry: auth, pagination, rate limits, and handling schema changes. Both Elastic integrations and one-off custom integrations.
  • Keep the Elastic Cloud on Kubernetes clusters healthy. Monitor and upgrade them regularly. This involves updating versions and builds. Manage capacity and shards. Handle index lifecycle management (ILM). Enable cross-cluster search (CCS).
  • Use Terraform to manage cloud infrastructure and Elasticsearch resources. This includes managing pipelines, index templates, and alerts. Utilize Kubernetes and Helm to deploy scheduled ingest jobs.
  • Use AI automation and tooling to reduce toil. This includes self-healing jobs and health checks. It also involves alerting, internal CLIs, and AI or agent-assisted workflows for investigation and operations.
  • Data quality & reliability - Own the "is the security data actually flowing correctly?" question. Monitor backfills. Ensure that schemas and fields are consistent. Keep an eye on costs.

What You Bring :

  • Ability to operate Elastic and Elasticsearch in production. This includes managing ingest pipelines, index templates, mappings, and queries, while ensuring that clusters are healthy and upgraded. Experience with ECK or Elasticsearch on Kubernetes is strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and accelerate operations, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • Kubernetes - deploying and operating workloads (scheduled jobs, Helm charts, operators); troubleshooting pods/jobs in a cluster.
  • Terraform - managing cloud and Elasticsearch resources as code.
  • API integration - consuming REST APIs for data ingestion: authentication, pagination, rate limiting concurrency, and error handling.
  • Python scripting - able to read, write, and modify ingestion/automation scripts. Scripting-level, not full software-engineering depth.

Bonus Points :

  • Experience with cloud providers.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud providers, preferably GCP, and working with audit and logging data.
  • Knowledge of GitHub, PR-based workflows, GitHub Actions and Continuous Integration (CI).
  • Knowledge of SOC operations and incident response (IR) workflows, including the use of security telemetry during investigations.
  • Ability to develop and use dashboard/visualization tools.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
  • Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. title: Senior Infrastructure Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction.

Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in.

We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute.

The Way We Work

The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Move with Urgency: We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping.
  • Take Ownership: We own outcomes, not just our individual work. We make decisions that move the company forward and follow through.
  • Communicate Openly: We communicate directly, seek to understand, and create clarity for others. Honest conversations help us move faster together.
  • Build Great Teams: We lead by example, empower others, and create healthy teams where people can do their best work.
  • Raise the Bar: We're always improving ourselves. We learn from feedback, consistently challenge ourselves to grow, and focus on the work that matters most.
  • Think Long-Term: We design for what's next. We create scalable systems, simplify complexity, and use AI and automation to amplify our impact.
 

About the Role

Lightning AI is seeking a Senior Infrastructure Software Engineer to join our Infrastructure Engineering team.

Our Infrastructure Engineering team builds the software systems that operate and manage Lightning AI’s large-scale GPU and bare-metal infrastructure. We develop services, APIs, tooling, and automation that bridge the gap between our physical infrastructure and the systems our customers depend on for AI/ML training, inference, and HPC workloads.

In this role, you will build production software and automation that support infrastructure throughout its lifecycle, from provisioning and bring-up through monitoring, maintenance, and decommissioning. You will design systems that enable engineers and software to interact programmatically with thousands of servers, storage systems, and high-performance networks, reducing manual operations and making infrastructure management more reliable, repeatable, and scalable.

This is a software-first infrastructure role that combines strong software engineering with Linux systems and hardware-aware infrastructure automation. You will work closely with teams across Infrastructure, Networking, Data Center Operations, and Platform Engineering to bring new capacity online and continuously improve how we operate our infrastructure at scale.

This role may be fully remote within the U.S., or hybrid out of one of our office hubs (NYC, SF, Seattle, or London), with occasional team and company offsites. We are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time.

What You Will Do

Infrastructure Software & Automation

  • Design, build, and operate production services, APIs, tooling, and automation for managing large-scale bare-metal and GPU infrastructure
  • Build and extend software systems that support infrastructure provisioning, configuration, monitoring, and lifecycle management
  • Develop reliable automation that reduces manual operational work and improves the consistency and scalability of infrastructure management
  • Build tools and interfaces that enable engineers and other systems to interact programmatically with physical infrastructure

Provisioning & Lifecycle Management

  • Build and extend systems for server discovery, provisioning, configuration, validation, and lifecycle management
  • Automate infrastructure bring-up and capacity deployment across large fleets of compute systems
  • Integrate software and automation with hardware management and provisioning systems
  • Improve tooling and workflows for managing infrastructure throughout its production lifecycle

Reliability & Observability

  • Build telemetry, logging, and observability capabilities that provide visibility into the health of our infrastructure
  • Develop tools and automation to identify, diagnose, and respond to infrastructure and hardware issues
  • Translate recurring operational issues and hardware failure modes into improvements to software, tooling, and automation
  • Improve the reliability and scalability of infrastructure operations as the fleet grows

Architecture & Collaboration

  • Partner with Network, Infrastructure Operations, Data Center, Platform Engineering, and other teams to define requirements and build new infrastructure capabilities
  • Participate in architectural discussions and help define the technical direction of Lightning AI’s infrastructure software
  • Make pragmatic design decisions that balance reliability, scalability, simplicity, and speed of execution
  • Write clear design documents and technical documentation and contribute to engineering best practices

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering, infrastructure engineering, or related experience
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production backend systems in Python or similar object-oriented programming languages
  • Strong experience with Linux in production environments
  • Experience building APIs, tooling, or automation for managing infrastructure at scale
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration concepts
  • Understanding of HPC and bare-metal infrastructure fundamentals, including provisioning and out-of-band management
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and make pragmatic architecture decisions while building for long-term reliability and scale
  • Experience working in a startup or other fast-paced environment with a high degree of ownership and autonomy

Ideal Experience

  • Experience with bare-metal hardware troubleshooting and provisioning, including technologies such as PXE/iPXE, BMC, Redfish, or IPMI, particularly with Dell hardware
  • Experience with GPU servers, either in bare-metal environments or under virtualization
  • Experience with network switches, routers, and firewalls, particularly SONiC switches, Palo Alto firewalls, or Juniper Networks
  • Experience with high-performance storage systems, particularly VAST
  • Experience supporting AI/ML or HPC infrastructure at scale

Compensation

We are committed to offering competitive compensation that reflects the value each team member brings to our mission. Final offers are based on factors such as experience, skills, geographic location, and role expectations. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package for eligible roles includes a discretionary bonus, a meaningful equity component, and comprehensive benefits.

The anticipated annual base salary range for this role is:$180,000—$220,000 USD

Benefits and Perks

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and long-term success:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents.
  • Meaningful Equity: RSUs that give employees a stake in the company's long-term success.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) matching (U.S.) and pension contributions (U.K.).
  • Flexible Time Off: Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and floating holidays to support work-life balance.
  • Company-Wide Winter Break: Two weeks of company closure each winter to disconnect and recharge.
  • Paid Parental & Family Leave: Paid leave to support you and your family through life's important moments.
  • Professional Development: Annual learning and development allowance to support your professional growth.
  • Wellness Benefits: Wellness and work-from-home stipends to support your physical and mental well-being.
  • Sabbatical Program: Four weeks of paid sabbatical leave after four years of service.
  • Flexible Work: Flexible schedules and a hybrid work model for our office-based teams.
  • In-Office Meals: Complimentary meals at our office hubs.

Benefits may vary by location, team, and role.

title: Senior Legal Counsel
descriptionHtml:
Legal Europe is a trusted partner to the business, playing a critical role in enabling commercial growth while managing legal and regulatory risk for our European trading businesses 

We're looking for an experienced financial markets lawyer who can operate as a trusted adviser to the business from day one. You’ll lead complex negotiations, advise senior stakeholders, and take ownership of significant legal matters in a fast-moving environment where your advice has direct commercial impact.

What you'll do 

As a Senior Legal Counsel, you will work closely with trading, compliance, risk, finance, operations and technology teams. You will support the businesses and trading desks covered by the Legal Europe team, including our European listed derivatives, commodities, and systematic trading businesses. The role is primarily focused on listed markets and market infrastructure. 

Proximity to trading is fundamental to the way we work. You will partner directly with traders and business leaders, developing a deep understanding of the products, markets, and commercial objectives of the desks you support. Experience advising on relevant trading products or market structures will be a significant advantage. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Leading legal support for key business initiatives and acting as the primary legal adviser to assigned trading desks. 
  • Advising traders and business stakeholders on legal issues arising from market making, exchange trading, listed derivatives, clearing and related market infrastructure. 
  • Challenging stakeholders where appropriate and helping shape commercial outcomes through clear, pragmatic legal advice. 
  • Drafting, reviewing and negotiating trading and commercial documentation, including: futures and options clearing agreements; prime brokerage agreements; execution, brokerage and market access agreements; exchange and market infrastructure documentation; market data, connectivity and trading technology agreements; and other commercial agreements supporting the trading business. 
  • Providing pragmatic advice on market structure, trading regulation, market conduct and legal risk affecting the European trading business. 
  • Working closely with our compliance and risk teams to develop practical solutions that appropriately balance business objectives and legal risk. 
  • Supporting strategic projects, including new market launches, legal entity expansions, and growth initiatives. 
  • Managing external counsel where specialist jurisdictional or product expertise is required. 
  • Developing scalable legal processes, templates, playbooks and technology-enabled solutions that improve the effectiveness of the legal function. 
  • Contributing to the continued development of Legal as a proactive, commercially focused business partner 

Who you are

  • Qualified lawyer in England & Wales.  
  • 8–15 years' post-qualification experience, with most of that experience focused on financial markets, derivatives, or trading.  
  • Experience within the markets legal function of an investment bank or other financial markets participant. Experience at a leading international law firm with a recognised financial markets, derivatives or trading practice is also desirable.  
  • Demonstrable experience advising trading businesses on legal and commercial issues. Experience advising on trading regulation as part of a broader markets legal practice is required, including close partnership with front-office trading businesses. 
  • Strong experience negotiating complex financial markets agreements, including execution agreements, brokerage agreements, exchange documentation, clearing documentation, market access arrangements, market data agreements, or other trading-related contracts.  
  • A strong understanding of financial market infrastructure, including exchanges, central counterparties, clearing brokers, and execution models.  
  • The judgement and confidence to lead negotiations independently, balance legal and commercial risk, and provide pragmatic advice without close supervision.  
  • Outstanding drafting, analytical and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex legal issues clearly to traders, technologists and senior management.  
  • Ability to manage multiple high priority matters simultaneously while exercising sound judgement in a fast-moving environment.  
  • Intellectual curiosity and a genuine interest in understanding the products, strategies and markets that underpin Optiver's trading business. 
  • A collaborative, low-ego approach and a genuine enjoyment of working as part of a high-performing team. You build trusted relationships through sound judgement, responsiveness and high-quality execution, and are known for being approachable, pragmatic, and easy to work with. 

Nice to have 

  • Experience at a proprietary trading firm or market maker.  
  • Experience supporting algorithmic or electronic trading businesses.  
  • Familiarity with MiFID II, UK MiFIR and exchange rulebooks.  
  • Experience implementing scalable legal processes or legal technology.  
  • Experience supporting strategic business projects. 

Who we are

At Optiver, our mission is to constantly improve the market by injecting liquidity, providing accurate pricing, increasing transparency and acting as a stabilizing force no matter the market conditions. With a focus on continuous improvement, we participate in the safeguarding of healthy and efficient markets for everyone who participates. As one of the largest market making institutions, we are a trusted partner of 70+ exchanges across the globe.

What you'll get

You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talented colleagues, working collectively to tackle the toughest problems in the financial markets. 

In addition, you’ll receive: 

  • A performance-based bonus structure, enabling all of our employees to benefit from our global profit pool. 
  • 27 paid vacation days plus all UK public holidays. 
  • Daily breakfast and lunch, along with support on commuting expenses. 
  • Private medical insurance, pension scheme, and ClassPass fitness membership. 
  • Training and continuous learning opportunities, including access to conferences and tech events. 
  • International transfer opportunities for global career growth

Apply directly via the form below. If you have any questions feel free to contact our Recruitment team via our recruitment inquiry form.

Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

Synthesia is growing fast, and lifecycle is how we turn that growth into lasting customer relationships, guiding every user from first signup to real value. Every month we send 150+ emails to 1+ million contacts, and as we launch new products and enter new markets, that scale and its impact on revenue will keep rising.

You’ll own the product-led growth motion after signup: the journeys that turn new users into activated, paying and expanding customers. You’ll partner with Product, Product Marketing and Data teams to build a lifecycle engine that grows with the company.

We’d be particularly excited if

  • 6+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM or email marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or product-led companies

title: Senior Match-3 Designer, New Game
descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for a talented and highly experienced Senior Match-3 Designer (internally Game Designer) to join our lovely and ambitious game team and help craft fun, rewarding and memorable puzzle experiences for our cozy mobile game.

You’ll own the overall match-3 gameplay experience, helping to define how the puzzle game feels to play while delivering best-in-class levels that strike the right balance of challenge, progression and delight. From core gameplay tuning and mechanic development through to polished, data-informed level iterations, you’ll take ownership of the player experience and continually raise the quality bar.

You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience.

As a senior member of the team, you’ll also help shape our level production strategy, driving quality with both internal development and external partners while contributing to the long-term direction of the game.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build and balance exceptional match-3 levels that deliver engaging gameplay across a wide range of player skill levels.

  • Collaborate with developers to tune game feel and match 3 gameplay to be best-in-class

  • Own the design of blockers, boosters and rewards and shape satisfying level progression

  • Use analytics, player feedback and playtesting to continuously refine levels and improve player experience.

  • Work alongside Engineering to improve level design tools, workflows and implementation processes.

  • Partner with Art to ensure levels are visually readable, aesthetically cohesive and support the game’s creative vision.

  • Plan and own Match 3 content production, ensuring a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that supports development milestones and LiveOps.

    • Lead external level design contractors and outsourcing partners by providing clear briefs, regular feedback and quality reviews, ensuring all delivered content meets Treefrog’s standards.

  • Mentor other designers through feedback, knowledge sharing and collaborative problem solving.

What You Have

  • Experience shipping successful free-to-play match-3 or puzzle games.

  • Experience designing LiveOps events, seasonal content or limited-time game modes.

  • Strong understanding of player progression, retention, engagement and monetisation in puzzle.

  • Experience improving level editors, pipelines or content creation workflows.

  • Experience leading small feature teams or mentoring designers.

  • Have a deep understanding of the competition and genre trends.

  • Passion for cosy games and creating emotionally engaging player experiences.

  • A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

What We're Looking for

  • A strong sense of ownership, with the ability to drive work forward autonomously.

  • A consistent track record of delivering high-quality work that meets design requirements and project goals.

  • A proactive mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and solve problems.

  • Sound judgement in balancing creative excellence with production efficiency.

  • The ability to lead external partners with clarity, empathy and high standards.

  • A collaborative approach to sharing knowledge, mentoring designers and raising the team’s quality bar.

  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to constructively challenge decisions.

  • A player-first mindset, balanced with an understanding of creative, technical and commercial goals.

  • A commitment to fostering a collaborative, inclusive and positive team culture.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in our London office. The team values in-person collaboration and typically works from the office three days a week: Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

You Are Not Your Job Title ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Benefits and Compensation

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

Relocation? Yes!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

Not Sure if You Should Apply?

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

title: Senior Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
About Aibidia

Aibidia is a fast-growing SaaS company transforming how multinational businesses manage transfer pricing. We're building intelligent, scalable software that simplifies complex tax and compliance processes, helping some of the world's largest organisations work more efficiently and confidently.

We're a team that values curiosity, ownership and pragmatic problem-solving. As we continue to evolve our products and embrace AI-native ways of working, we're looking for a Design Engineer to help shape the next generation of our platform.

The Role

We're looking for an AI-first Senior Product Designer who combines strong technical capabilities with a solid understanding of product design, UX and usability.

This is a hybrid role at the intersection of design and engineering. You'll work on complex, data-rich enterprise software, using modern AI tools to rapidly prototype, iterate and deliver intuitive product experiences.

We're not looking for someone who simply creates beautiful interfaces or follows traditional, lengthy design processes. We want someone who thinks systematically, understands how software is built and knows how to leverage AI to turn complex requirements into functional, user-friendly solutions.

You'll join a team that has already established an AI-first design system and modern ways of working. Rather than reinventing what's already in place, you'll build on these foundations, contributing to an evolving design system while helping us move towards faster, more iterative product development.

What You'll Do

Design, prototype and ship

  • Translate complex business requirements and user needs into intuitive, functional product experiences.

  • Rapidly prototype and iterate on new features using AI-powered tools, getting working solutions in front of users early.

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers and domain experts to take ideas from concept through to implementation.

  • Balance usability, technical feasibility and speed of delivery, knowing when to iterate and when a solution is good enough to ship.

  • Design for complex, data-heavy workflows where clarity, efficiency and accuracy matter more than visual embellishment.

Build with an AI-first mindset

  • Use AI tools such as Claude, Figma and MCP integrations as a core part of your design and development workflow.

  • Experiment with emerging AI technologies, agents and workflows to continuously improve how we build products.

Contribute to our design system

  • Understand and apply design system principles, including components, design tokens, spacing, layouts, accessibility and interaction patterns.

Collaborate and validate

  • Work directly with users and internal stakeholders to understand problems, validate ideas and gather feedback.

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering to ensure designs are technically achievable and can be efficiently implemented.

  • Continuously refine solutions based on user feedback, technical constraints and evolving business needs.

What We're Looking For

  • A hybrid design and engineering background, with hands-on coding capabilities and a strong understanding of UX, UI and usability principles.

  • Strong systems thinking, with an understanding of how scalable design systems, reusable components and technical frameworks work together.

  • Experience contributing to design systems, with knowledge of design tokens, component libraries, accessibility and established UI patterns.

  • Experience working directly with codebases, GitHub and modern frontend technologies, rather than operating solely within traditional design tools.

  • Experience designing or building complex, data-dense B2B SaaS, enterprise or workflow-driven products.

  • Experience working in a startup or scaleup environment, where priorities evolve, teams are lean and speed of execution matters.

  • Strong product judgement and the ability to balance user needs, business requirements and technical constraints.

  • A curious, adaptable mindset and enthusiasm for experimenting with emerging technologies and new ways of working.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, tax technology, compliance or other complex, regulated industries.

  • Exposure to both early-stage startups and larger, more established software organisations.


Why Join Aibidia?

  • Build the future of AI-first product development: Help shape how AI is embedded into the way we design, prototype and ship software.

  • Solve genuinely complex problems: Work on sophisticated enterprise software where thoughtful design and usability have a meaningful impact.

  • Make an impact: Join a lean, collaborative team where your ideas, technical judgement and contributions directly influence the product.

title: Senior Product Manager - Data Lake (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Notre Team Data lake recherche un·e Senior Product Manager (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Lille ou Paris

Chez Decathlon, nous croyons au pouvoir du sport pour unir et inspirer. Notre mission : au travers du sport rendre le bien être accessible au plus grand nombre, partout dans le monde. Pour y parvenir, la data est au cœur de notre stratégie, elle guide chaque décision, de la conception du produit à l'expérience client.

Au cœur de l’entité Decathlon Digital, nous recherchons notre futur.e Senior Product Manager pour rejoindre les équipes Data Factory.

Cette plateforme technologique, globale à tout le groupe de manière internationale, soutient le développement de l’usage de la Data et de l’IA chez Decathlon, du calcul du chiffre d’affaires à l’aide de conception de produits innovants.

Nous sommes garants des outils, de la scalabilité, de la mise en place et du respect des bonnes pratiques de développement. Nous accompagnons au quotidien l’ensemble des acteurs métiers tels que Data Analysts, Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists.

La Data Factory est conçue comme une Modern Data Stack, avec un lakehouse comme centre de gravité.

Elle est ensuite divisée en plusieurs équipes, chacune étant pilotée par un leader technique, avec comme ambition de travailler avec un.e Product Manager attitré.e.

Notre équipe Data Lake est donc la brique fondamentale de cette mission.

Notre mission ? Mettre à disposition des solutions de stockage pour l’ensemble de la Data Platform de Decathlon, tout en garantissant la gouvernance, robustesse et scalabilité par défaut. Véritable pilier de la gouvernance technique du patrimoine de données, notre équipe gère les métadonnées via le metastore Unity Catalog et les data contracts, permettant ainsi de construire une observabilité globale de la plateforme (usage, lignage, etc.). Un terrain de jeu technique à fort impact et aux défis d'envergure internationale !

L'équipe est composée actuellement de :

  • 1 Product Manager
  • 1 Data Architect
  • 1 Data Engineer
  • 1 Software Engineer
  • 2 Ops Engineer

Exemples de challenges actuels :

  • Améliorer notre offre de support pour faciliter le parcours utilisateur (documentation, gestion des incidents, ...)
  • Discussion avec les équipes Data/IA des pays et domaines sur leurs challenges du moment (données sensibles, données privées, ...) pour définir les priorités de nos équipes
  • Comment faciliter la gouvernance des données ? Par exemple intégrer des règles automatiques de validation des données, data contractualization, ...
  • Rationalisation de notre offre et décommissionnement du legacy

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

Notre ambition groupe, celle d’améliorer l’expérience digitale de nos clients, nous amène à une nouvelle approche orientée clients, une approche produit.

Le/La Product Manager de l'équipe Data Lake:

  • Acquiert une compréhension de son périmètre, de l'état de l’art sur le marché, du fonctionnement technique des outils associés.
  • Représente nos utilisateurs métiers, comprend leurs challenges et les retranscrit aux équipes techniques.
  • Accompagne la mise en œuvre de nouvelles fonctionnalités ou produits sur tout le cycle de vie (démo, formation, communication, documentation, …).


Tu seras garant·e de l'évolution et de la robustesse de ce produit critique pour l'ensemble des équipes Decathlon.

Tes missions principales s'articuleront autour des axes suivants :

  • Vision & Delivery : Tu pilotes le cycle complet du produit, de la Discovery à la coordination du Delivery en lien étroit avec le Leader. Tu traduis les enjeux business et techniques en une roadmap claire, priorisée et axée sur la valeur.

  • Projets Stratégiques : Tu lead l'End-of-Life (EOL) de notre Legacy, orchestres la migration vers la nouvelle infrastructure et designs les nouveaux espaces et fonctionnalités sur Unity Catalog.

  • Gouvernance & Excellence Opérationnelle : Tu assures la gouvernance fine du metastore, la gestion des droits d'accès et intègres au cœur de ta roadmap les enjeux de sécurité, de performance, de maintenance et de FinOps (optimisation des coûts cloud).

  • Leadership Fonctionnel & Synergies : Tu assures le management fonctionnel de l'équipe technique au quotidien et tu pourras être amené·e à animer un groupe transverse de PM sur des sujets communs afin de garantir l'alignement de notre vision produit globale.

  • Mesure de l'impact : Tu définis et suis les indicateurs clés de réussite focalisés sur la fiabilité, la robustesse de la plateforme et la mesure précise de l'usage de tes produits. Tu co-animes le budget du produit avec le leader.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Expérience : Tu justifies d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience comme Product Manager, avec une légitimité et une réussite reconnues sur des produits complexes ou de plateforme.

  • Expertise Technique & Data : Tu possèdes une forte appétence technique ainsi qu'une solide compréhension des enjeux liés à la gestion des données, aux accès et à la gouvernance. Savoir manipuler la donnée est un réel plus pour ce poste.

  • Culture Tech & IA : Tu maîtrises les outils d'Intelligence Artificielle appliqués au Product Management et tu appréhendes parfaitement les défis techniques sous-jacents (sécurité, infrastructure, scalabilité).

  • Soft Skills : Orienté·e utilisateur, tu as un fort sens du service. Tu aimes écouter, creuser des sujets de fond et proposer des solutions innovantes.

  • Communication & Fédérateur·rice : Tu disposes d'excellentes capacités de communication pour vulgariser des concepts complexes, dialoguer aussi bien avec des profils techniques que métiers, et fédérer autour de ta vision.

  • Langues & Mindset : Un niveau d'anglais courant (B2 minimum, écrit et oral) est requis pour évoluer dans notre contexte international. Tu es motivé·e, curieux·se, ambitieux·se et tu as le goût du challenge.

  • L'étincelle Decathlon : Tu es passionné·e de sport, tu as envie de partager tes passions en équipe et de rejoindre une entreprise à impact positif !


STACK TECHNIQUE

  • AWS S3, Glue
  • Databricks Lakehouse, Unity Catalog
  • Data contracts
  • Business Intelligence : Tableau
  • Compute et Orchestration : Spark / Scala,  Python,  Airflow, dbt
  • Ops : Terraform, Kubernetes
  • Product Management : Jira Product Discovery, Github, Confluence
  • IA : Gemini, Github Copilot

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Organisation de travail hybride ;

  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;

  • Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;

  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;

  • Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITE

Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de toutes capacités à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es.

Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. En cas de besoin d'aménagement, tu peux en faire la demande via le formulaire de candidature, celle-ci sera confidentielle. Ces demandes n'affectent pas le résultat du processus de recrutement.

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

Changing your car should feel like one seamless journey, not a series of disconnected tasks. Right now it's the opposite: people value their car in one place, search for the next one in another, and manage the handover somewhere else, much of it on the web and most of it forgotten between car changes. The Carwow app is our most direct relationship with those customers, and today it is nowhere near what it could be.

We are reimagining it. If we can give people a reason to open Carwow between car changes, understand what they drive and what they want next, and make the moment of changing effortless, the app becomes the place UK drivers start. This role is the product voice at the table for that: setting the direction for what we build and working day to day with design and engineering to build it.

This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. The best consumer apps of the next few years won't be lists with filters; they will understand you and act on your behalf. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, the fluency to prototype it quickly with the latest tools, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise.

If you want to shape a new consumer product from the ground up, work at the cutting edge of applied AI, and build things that millions of UK drivers could use, this is it.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Product Strategy & Execution:

    • Set the product direction for the Carwow consumer app, defining what we build, in what order, and why

    • Lead discovery work with consumers: interviews, usage data, behavioural analysis, to build a precise understanding of where the app can add the most value

    • Identify, prototype and ship opportunities to bring AI into the app: smarter discovery, personalisation and recommendations that actually change behaviour

    • Collaborate with the Engineering Manager, Designer and Engineers as a product trio to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics

    • Manage the backlog with commercial awareness, prioritising work that drives engagement, retention and revenue, not just activity

  • Design & Engineering Partnership:

    • Work shoulder to shoulder with design to shape journeys and screens from the ground up, and test them with users before engineering starts

    • Work with engineers on the right trade-offs for a native app: release cadence, quality and what to build versus reuse

    • Use AI tools every day in your own work, prototyping, synthesising research and analysing data, so the squad learns faster and ships more

  • Cross-functional Leadership:

    • Work across product, engineering, data, CRM and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently

    • Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal

    • Own the app's success measures and bring clean evidence, including holdouts and controlled tests, to decisions on what to scale, change or stop

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including time owning a consumer mobile app, with evidence of improving engagement or retention metrics

  • Hands-on experience with product discovery: you run your own interviews, interrogate your own data, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for research to land in your inbox

  • AI-native: you use AI tools daily, you have shipped or prototyped AI-powered features, and you have a clear point of view on where it adds real value for consumers

  • Comfort with ambiguity: this role involves defining the problem as much as solving it, and the scope will evolve as evidence comes in

  • A proven partnership with design and engineering: you have worked as a product trio and can hold a credible conversation about journeys, architecture and app quality

  • Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in automotive, marketplace or two-sided consumer products

  • Familiarity with habit loops and engagement design in a consumer app: push, onboarding, personalisation

  • Background in scale-up or high-growth environments

  • Experience taking new products to market, including GTM planning and launch

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU
